title: QuAD: Quantitative Assessment via Distribution-Alignment for Qualitative Data Quality Enabled by a Content-Aware Multi-Agent System
title_zh: QuAD：借助内容感知多智能体系统实现基于分布对齐的定性数据质量定量评估

paragraphs.en: Assessing whether qualitative responses collected from semi-structured questions are ready for a particular analysis goal is a persistent challenge. Manual qualitative analysis is interpretive and labor-intensive, while existing automated methods often lack a dataset-level perspective for deciding whether a response set supports a researcher-selected analytical lens. We introduce QuAD , a framework for quantitative pre-analysis assessment of qualitative response datasets. QuAD compares a reconstructed intrinsic cluster distribution reconstructed from responses with an extrinsic, researcher-defined analytical lens derived from metadata. QuAD is structured into a four-quadrant assessment whose metrics are read jointly, from lens-level relations to within-cluster variation, to provide fitness-for-purpose signals for revealing general patterns and unique insights. Because this assessment relies on lens-conditioned inter-response dissimilarity, we propose a content-aware multi-agent system with two-stage instruction generation and adaptive anchors to improve scoring consistency. We validate QuAD through controlled experiments on synthetic data, including robustness and baseline comparisons, and a real-world social survey case study. The case study shows how QuAD quantitatively assesses whether a selected analysis axis is promising and also surfaces representative or unusual responses for human interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 评估从半结构化问题中收集的定性回答是否适合特定分析目标，是一个持续存在的挑战。 手动定性分析具有解释性且耗费人力，而现有的自动化方法往往缺乏数据集层面的视角来判断一组回答是否支持研究者选定的分析视角。 我们提出了 QuAD，一个用于定性回答数据集定量预分析评估的框架。 QuAD 将从回答中重构的内在聚类分布与从元数据中提取的、由研究者定义的外在分析视角进行比较。 QuAD 被构建为一个四象限评估，其指标需要联合解读，从视角层面的关系到聚类内部的变异，从而提供适合目的的信号，用于揭示普遍模式和独特洞见。 由于该评估依赖于以视角为条件的回答间相异性，我们提出一个内容感知的多智能体系统，采用两阶段指令生成和自适应锚点来提高评分一致性。 我们通过在合成数据上的受控实验（包括鲁棒性和基线比较）以及一个真实世界社会调查案例研究来验证 QuAD。 案例研究展示了 QuAD 如何定量评估所选分析轴是否有前景，同时还能呈现代表性或不寻常的回答供人类解读。

paragraphs.en: Semi-structured questions play a crucial role in studies involving human participants. They enable researchers to gather detailed qualitative responses, uncovering general patterns and unique insights across demographic groups (e.g., age, gender). For example, in a study on student well-being, a question like “How have your eating habits changed since starting college?” might reveal general patterns, such as freshmen reporting poorer diets, as well as unique insights from unexpected cases, such as freshmen who are student-athletes maintaining healthy eating habits due to their training (a reason read by the researcher). Traditionally, such responses are analyzed through iterative procedures such as familiarization, open coding, theme grouping, interpretation, and validation, with attention to codebooks, intercoder reliability, data saturation, and the richness or thickness of the evidence ( Denzin and Lincoln, 2011 ; Glaser and Strauss, 2017 ; Campbell et al., 2013 ; Ames et al., 2024 ; Naeem et al., 2024 ) . These methods are essential for interpretation and theory building, but usually follow data collection and need substantial human effort.
paragraphs.zh: 半结构化问题在涉及人类参与者的研究中起着至关重要的作用。 它们使研究者能够收集详细的定性回答，揭示不同人口群体（如年龄、性别）中的一般模式和独特见解。 例如，在一项关于学生福祉的研究中，像“自上大学以来，你的饮食习惯发生了哪些变化？”这样的问题可能揭示出一般模式，例如新生报告饮食变差；同时也能从意想不到的案例中获得独特见解，例如作为学生运动员的新生由于训练而保持健康的饮食习惯（这是由研究者阅读得出的原因）。 传统上，这类回答需通过熟悉数据、开放编码、主题归类、解释和验证等迭代程序进行分析，并需关注编码手册、编码者间信度、数据饱和度以及证据的丰富性或厚度（Denzin and Lincoln, 2011；Glaser and Strauss, 2017；Campbell et al., 2013；Ames et al., 2024；Naeem et al., 2024）。 这些方法对解释和理论构建至关重要，但通常在数据收集之后进行，且需要大量人力投入。

paragraphs.en: Pre-analysis assessment of a qualitative response dataset is crucial before conducting full coding or interpretation. Without it, researchers risk investing effort in an analysis lens that the collected responses do not support, or overlooking cross-group patterns and unusual cases that deserve closer inspection. Existing evaluation methods are insufficient. Manual approaches do not scale and lack quantitative outputs to guide data improvement ( Mattimoe et al., 2021 ; Campbell et al., 2013 ) . Most automated methods evaluate responses in isolation ( Chen et al., 2023b ; Swayamdipta et al., 2020 ) , overlooking inter-response relations and dataset structure crucial for comparative knowledge discovery ( Fayyad et al., 1996 ; Glaser and Strauss, 2017 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在进行完整编码或解释之前，对定性回答数据集进行预分析评估至关重要。 若缺少这一步，研究者可能会把精力投入到所收集回答无法支持的分析视角上，或者忽视值得深入考察的跨群体模式和异常案例。 现有的评估方法并不充分。 人工方法难以规模化，且缺乏用于指导数据改进的量化输出（Mattimoe et al., 2021；Campbell et al., 2013）。 大多数自动化方法孤立地评估单个回答（Chen et al., 2023b；Swayamdipta et al., 2020），忽视了回答之间的关系以及数据集结构，而这些对比较性知识发现至关重要（Fayyad et al., 1996；Glaser and Strauss, 2017）。

paragraphs.en: Rather than focusing on individual responses, we propose QuAD , a quantitative pre-analysis assessment method that evaluates a response dataset as a whole, estimating whether a qualitative dataset is fit for a selected analysis goal by comparing its internal response structure with a researcher-defined analytical lens. The lens may be derived from demographic metadata such as age, gender, grade level, or expertise, and acts as an external hypothesis rather than ground truth for qualitative insight. Strong alignment between response structure and the lens suggests that the dataset supports group-level general patterns along this lens. Divergence is also informative: it may signal cross-group consensus, latent factors beyond the selected metadata, or unusual responses worth closer qualitative interpretation. The core idea of QuAD is to quantitatively (1) measuring the alignment and divergence between a metadata-derived analytical distribution and a cluster distribution empirically derived from responses, and (2) examining variation within the cluster distribution itself. It also locates representative responses in dense regions and candidate unusual ones in outlying or cross-lens regions.
paragraphs.zh: 与其关注单个回答，我们提出了 QuAD，一种定量的预分析评估方法，它将回答数据集作为整体进行评估，通过将其内部回答结构与研究者定义的分析透镜进行比较，来估计定性数据集是否适合选定的分析目标。 该透镜可以源自人口统计元数据，例如年龄、性别、年级或专业水平，并作为外部假设而非定性洞察的真值。 回答结构与透镜之间的高度一致表明该数据集支持沿此透镜的群体层面的总体模式。 分歧同样具有信息量：它可能表明跨组共识、超出所选元数据的潜在因素，或值得进一步定性解读的异常回答。 QuAD 的核心思想是定量地 (1) 衡量由元数据导出的分析分布与从回答中经验导出的聚类分布之间的一致性与分歧，以及 (2) 检验聚类分布自身的内部变异。 它还能在高密度区域定位代表性回答，并在离群或跨透镜区域定位候选的异常回答。

paragraphs.en: More specifically, QuAD consists of two components. First, a four-quadrant assessment framework operationalizes the comparison between the cluster and metadata-derived analytical distributions (Sec. 3.2 ). This framework yields four complementary metrics, read jointly as one profile, that characterize a dataset’s utility for discovering general patterns versus unique insights at both the distribution and data-point levels. The four quadrants rely on the distributions reconstructed via metadata and inter-response dissimilarities. Therefore, QuAD integrates a content-aware multi-agent system to compute task-conditioned inter-response dissimilarity (Sec. 3.1 ). To be more reliable and domain-aware, it enhances the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) with two innovations. First, a novel interactive instruction generation system enables efficient, domain-specific instruction generation (Sec. 3.1.2 ), moving beyond manual or black-box methods ( Zhou et al., 2022 ; Shah, 2024 ; Pryzant et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023a ) . Second, a dynamic anchor updating algorithm (Sec. 3.1.3 ) maintains a stable semantic reference frame to ensure consistency and mitigate scoring drift, improving upon static example-based approaches ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 更具体地说，QuAD 由两个组件构成。 首先，一个四象限评估框架将聚类与基于元数据导出的分析分布之间的比较操作化（第 3.2 节）。 该框架产生四个互补的指标，作为一个整体来解读，用于刻画数据集在分布和数据点两个层面上发现一般模式与独特见解的效用。 四个象限依赖于通过元数据和响应间相异度重建的分布。 因此，QuAD 集成了一个内容感知的多智能体系统来计算任务条件下的响应间相异度（第 3.1 节）。 为了更可靠并更具领域感知能力，它通过两项创新增强了 LLM-as-a-Judge 范式（Zheng et al., 2023）。 首先，一个新颖的交互式指令生成系统能够高效地生成领域特定的指令（第 3.1.2 节），超越了手动或黑盒方法（Zhou et al., 2022；Shah, 2024；Pryzant et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2023a）。 其次，一种动态锚点更新算法（第 3.1.3 节）维护一个稳定的语义参考框架，以确保一致性并缓解评分漂移，改进了基于静态示例的方法（Yang et al., 2024；Dong et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: We validate QuAD through controlled experiments on synthetic data and a case study on a real-world qualitative social survey of student food choices. The results evaluate both the technical quality of dissimilarity extraction and the practical role of QuAD as a pre-analysis aid for qualitative research, rather than as a replacement for full thematic coding. In summary, our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过在合成数据上的受控实验以及一项关于学生食物选择的真实定性社会调查的案例研究来验证 QuAD。 评估结果既衡量了相异性提取的技术质量，也评估了 QuAD 作为定性研究预分析辅助工具（而非完全替代完整主题编码）的实际作用。 总之，我们的贡献如下：

sents.en: We validate QuAD through controlled experiments on synthetic data and a case study on a real-world qualitative social survey of student food choices.
sents.zh: 我们通过在合成数据上的受控实验以及一项关于学生食物选择的真实定性社会调查的案例研究来验证 QuAD。

sents.en: The results evaluate both the technical quality of dissimilarity extraction and the practical role of QuAD as a pre-analysis aid for qualitative research, rather than as a replacement for full thematic coding.
sents.zh: 评估结果既衡量了相异性提取的技术质量，也评估了 QuAD 作为定性研究预分析辅助工具（而非完全替代完整主题编码）的实际作用。

paragraphs.en: We propose a four-quadrant quantitative assessment framework for dissimilarity collected from semi-structured questions, based on comparing data-driven response structure with a researcher-defined analytical lens, whose four metrics are read jointly to quantify analysis readiness and also prioritize key responses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一个四象限定量评估框架，用于评估从半结构化问题中收集的差异性，该框架基于将数据驱动的回答结构与研究者定义的分析视角进行比较，其四个指标可联合解读，以量化分析就绪度并确定关键回答的优先级。

paragraphs.en: We design a content-aware multi-agent system to extract inter-response dissimilarity, featuring a human-in-the-loop iterative process for instruction generation and an adaptive anchor algorithm for evaluation consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种内容感知的多智能体系统，用于提取回复间的差异性，其特点包括用于指令生成的人在回路迭代过程，以及用于保证评估一致性的自适应锚点算法。

paragraphs.en: We conduct controlled experiments, including robustness checks, and a real-world study with existing thematic labels, validating QuAD and its components as a pre-analysis assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了对照实验，包括稳健性检验，以及一项使用现有主题标签的真实世界研究，验证了 QuAD 及其组成部分作为分析前评估的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Quality Evaluation of Qualitative Datasets. Qualitative dataset quality is commonly assessed through manual and interpretive practices such as coding, theme development, intercoder reliability checks, saturation, and richness/thickness assessment ( Glaser and Strauss, 2017 ; Campbell et al., 2013 ; Ames et al., 2024 ; Naeem et al., 2024 ) . These methods are central but occur after data collection and require substantial human effort. Existing automated NLP and LLM-based approaches improve individual-response assessment or qualitative coding support ( Chang et al., 2009 ; Chen et al., 2023b ; Dunivin, 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , but they provide limited dataset-level pre-analysis signals. QuAD addresses this gap by measuring whether an intrinsic response structure aligns with, diverges from, or is orthogonal to a researcher-defined analytical lens.
paragraphs.zh: 定性数据集的质量评估。 定性数据集的质量通常通过手动和解释性实践来评估，例如编码、主题开发、编码员间信度检验、饱和度以及丰富性/厚度评估（Glaser and Strauss, 2017；Campbell et al., 2013；Ames et al., 2024；Naeem et al., 2024）。 这些方法虽然至关重要，但发生在数据收集之后，且需要大量的人力投入。 现有的基于自然语言处理（NLP）和大语言模型（LLM）的自动化方法改进了对单条回答的评估或定性编码支持（Chang et al., 2009；Chen et al., 2023b；Dunivin, 2024；Liu et al., 2024），但它们提供的数据集层面预分析信号有限。 QuAD 通过测量内在回答结构是与研究者定义的分析视角相一致、相背离还是正交，来弥补这一空白。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based Automated Evaluation. LLM-as-a-Judge enables scalable evaluations ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2023 ) , yet suffers from bias and inconsistency (e.g., position/verbosity bias, prompt sensitivity, and scoring drift) ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . QuAD improves robustness for qualitative response assessment via interactive instruction generation and adaptive anchors that stabilize task-conditioned LLM dissimilarity scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 LLM 的自动化评估。 LLM-as-a-Judge 实现了可扩展的评估（Zheng et al., 2023; Kim et al., 2023），但存在偏差和不一致性问题（例如位置/冗长偏差、提示敏感性以及评分漂移）（Ye et al., 2024; Lee et al., 2025）。 QuAD 通过交互式指令生成和自适应锚点提升了定性响应评估的稳健性，这些锚点可稳定任务条件下的 LLM 相似度评分。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the overview of QuAD . The input of QuAD is a response dataset (Fig. 1 (A)) collecting free-text responses to a question, where each response is associated with metadata that can define a researcher-selected analytical lens. QuAD uses two components to assess the dataset’s fitness for this lens: (1) a content-aware multi-agent system (Fig. 1 (B)–(C)) that enhances the LLM-as-Judge paradigm to compute task-conditioned inter-response dissimilarity, and (2) a four-quadrant assessment framework (Fig. 1 (E)) that compares the cluster and metadata-derived distributions reconstructed from this dissimilarity. The pipeline runs in three steps. QuAD first generates a task-specific instruction via Two-stage Iterative Instruction Generation (Fig. 1 (B), Sec. 3.1.2 ), then computes a dissimilarity matrix with it, using Adaptive Anchor Manifold Maintenance (Fig. 1 (C), Sec. 3.1.3 ) to keep stable reference examples for the LLM evaluator. Finally, ensemble clustering of the matrix yields a cluster distribution, compared with the metadata-derived distribution (Fig. 1 (D), Sec. 3.2.2 ) in the four-quadrant assessment (Fig. 1 (E), Sec. 3.2.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图1展示了QuAD的概览。 QuAD的输入是一个回应数据集（图1 (A)），该数据集收集针对某个问题的自由文本回应，其中每个回应都关联着可定义研究者所选分析视角的元数据。 QuAD使用两个组件来评估数据集相对于该视角的适配性：（1）一个内容感知的多智能体系统（图1 (B)–(C)），它增强了LLM-as-Judge（LLM作为评判者）范式，以计算任务条件下的回应间差异性；（2）一个四象限评估框架（图1 (E)），它比较由该差异性重建的聚类分布与元数据导出的分布。 该流程分三步运行。 QuAD首先通过两阶段迭代指令生成（图1 (B)，第3.1.2节）生成一个任务特定的指令，然后用该指令计算差异性矩阵，并使用自适应锚点流形维护（图1 (C)，第3.1.3节）为LLM评估器保持稳定的参考示例。 最后，对该矩阵进行集成聚类得到聚类分布，并与元数据导出的分布（图1 (D)，第3.2.2节）在四象限评估（图1 (E)，第3.2.2节）中进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Automated Instruction Discovery. It generates diverse, high-quality, general-purpose instructions with a powerful LLM as Oracle ( O ≡ O LLM O\equiv O_{\text{LLM}} ). The process runs automatically, building instructions from scratch until a termination condition is met. This condition is also determined by O LLM O_{\text{LLM}} , acting as a strict evaluator that assesses the instruction against rigorous criteria for universality, clarity, and quality. The process halts when both the instruction and the evaluator E E using it score highly. This stage ends with a user selecting the most promising instruction P a ∗ P_{a}^{*} from the candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段一：自动化指令发现。 它以一个强大的 LLM 作为神谕（O ≡ O_LLM）来生成多样化、高质量、通用的指令。 该过程自动运行，从零开始构建指令，直到满足终止条件为止。 该终止条件同样由 O_LLM 决定，它充当严格的评估者，依据普适性、清晰度和质量等严格标准对指令进行评估。 当指令以及使用该指令的评估器 E 都获得高分时，该过程才会停止。 此阶段以用户从候选指令中选出最有前景的指令 P_a^* 结束。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2: Human-in-the-Loop Adaptation. sents.en: Each d i d_{i} has (i) an extrinsic analytical label y i ∈ { 1 , … , C } y_{i}\in\{1,\dots,C\} , derived from metadata ℐ i \mathcal{I}_{i} via a researcher-defined mapping y i = f ⁡ ( ℐ i ) y_{i}=f(\mathcal{I}_{i}) , which defines an external analytical partition 𝒫 = { C j } j = 1 C \mathcal{P}=\{C_{j}\}_{j=1}^{C} ; and (ii) an intrinsic cluster label y ^ i ∈ { 1 , … , K } \hat{y}_{i}\in\{1,\dots,K\} , obtained by clustering a dissimilarity matrix 𝐃 ∈ ℝ N × N \mathbf{D}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N} , which defines the cluster partition 𝒫 ^ = { C ^ k } k = 1 K \hat{\mathcal{P}}=\{\hat{C}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} and induces the cluster distribution .
sents.zh: 每个 d i d_{i} 具有：(i) 一个外在分析标签 y i ∈ { 1 , … , C } y_{i}\in\{1,\dots,C\} ，它由元数据 ℐ i \mathcal{I}_{i} 通过研究者定义的映射 y i = f ⁡ ( ℐ i ) y_{i}=f(\mathcal{I}_{i}) 得到，该映射定义了一个外部分析划分 𝒫 = { C j } j = 1 C \mathcal{P}=\{C_{j}\}_{j=1}^{C} ；以及 (ii) 一个内在聚类标签 y ^ i ∈ { 1 , … , K } \hat{y}_{i}\in\{1,\dots,K\} ，它通过对相异度矩阵 𝐃 ∈ ℝ N × N \mathbf{D}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N} 进行聚类得到，该聚类定义了聚类划分 𝒫 ^ = { C ^ k } k = 1 K \hat{\mathcal{P}}=\{\hat{C}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} 并诱导出聚类分布。

paragraphs.en: Objective: A researcher may use data for (1) finding common responses that represent groups under a selected analytical lens, general patterns , or (2) discovering previously unknown unique insights . These analyses have two granularities: the distribution level and the data-point level . Aligned with these practices, we define dataset quality as fitness-for-purpose for qualitative knowledge discovery rather than as a binary good/bad label. The four-quadrant assessment framework (Fig. 3 ) assigns one normalized metric to each goal–granularity pair: general-pattern metrics (GMR, DDR) measure how far the lens explains response structure, unique-insight metrics (DP, DC) describe what it leaves within clusters (group mixing and spread), data-point metrics (GMR, DP) count how individual responses are assigned, and distribution metrics (DDR, DC) aggregate continuous dissimilarities. The four metrics are read jointly to describe the concordance and divergence between the external analytical partition 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and the intrinsic cluster partition 𝒫 ^ \hat{\mathcal{P}} , together with the variation within clusters.
paragraphs.zh: 目标：研究者可以将数据用于（1）在选定分析视角下寻找代表群体的一般响应、总体模式，或（2）发现此前未知的独特洞察。 这些分析有两个粒度：分布层面和数据点层面。 与这些实践保持一致，我们将数据集质量定义为面向定性知识发现的适用性，而非二元的优/劣标签。 四象限评估框架（图 3）为每个目标–粒度配对分配一个归一化指标：一般模式指标（GMR、DDR）衡量该视角能在多大程度上解释响应结构，独特洞察指标（DP、DC）描述它在簇内部留下了什么（群体混合与离散程度），数据点指标（GMR、DP）统计各条响应如何被分配，分布指标（DDR、DC）聚合连续的不相似度。 这四个指标需联合解读，用以描述外部分析划分 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 与内在簇划分 𝒫 ^ \hat{\mathcal{P}} 之间的一致与分歧，以及簇内的变异。

paragraphs.en: (1) Demographic and Cluster Distributions
paragraphs.zh: (1) 人口统计与聚类分布

paragraphs.en: Extrinsic Analytical Distribution: This distribution is defined a priori from metadata on characteristics of interest. A researcher-defined function, y i = f ⁡ ( ℐ i ) y_{i}=f(\mathcal{I}_{i}) , maps attributes (e.g., expertise level or grade level) to an analytical label for each response d i d_{i} . The resulting vector 𝐲 = { y i } i = 1 N \mathbf{y}=\{y_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} represents an expected structure along the chosen axis. We treat 𝒫 \mathcal{P} as an external analysis hypothesis rather than ground truth for qualitative insight.
paragraphs.zh: 外部分析分布：该分布根据关于目标特征的元数据，以先验方式定义。 一个由研究者定义的函数 y i = f ⁡ ( ℐ i ) y_{i}=f(\mathcal{I}_{i}) ，将每个响应 d i d_{i} 的属性（例如专业水平或年级水平）映射到一个分析标签。 得到的向量 𝐲 = { y i } i = 1 N \mathbf{y}=\{y_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} 表示沿所选轴的一种预期结构。 我们将 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 视为一个外部分析假设，而非用于定性洞见的真值。

paragraphs.en: Intrinsic Cluster Distribution: This distribution is derived a posteriori from the data’s internal structure. A pairwise dissimilarity matrix 𝐃 \mathbf{D} is embedded in two dimensions with metric multidimensional scaling and fed into an ensemble of clustering, with multiple k-means runs and voting ( Ahmed et al., 2020 ) . This yields a vector of cluster assignments 𝐲 ^ = { y ^ i } i = 1 N \mathbf{\hat{y}}=\{\hat{y}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} . Since cluster labels are arbitrary, we align them with demographic labels via maximum weight bipartite matching, where the weight between a demographic group C j C_{j} and a cluster C ^ k \hat{C}_{k} is their IOU ( Yu et al., 2016 ) . This alignment makes the distributions comparable. We set K = C K=C so each analytical group has one matched cluster. The alignment only pairs clusters with groups and does not change which responses belong to which cluster, so a content cluster can still mix analytical groups.
paragraphs.zh: 内在聚类分布：该分布是从数据内部结构中事后推导得到的。 使用度量多维缩放将成对相异性矩阵 𝐃 \mathbf{D} 嵌入到二维空间中，并输入到一个聚类集成方法中，其中包含多次 k-means 运行和投票（Ahmed et al., 2020）。 由此得到一个聚类分配向量 𝐲 ^ = { y ^ i } i = 1 N \mathbf{\hat{y}}=\{\hat{y}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}。 由于聚类标签是任意的，我们通过最大权重二分匹配将其与人口群体标签对齐，其中人口群体 C j C_{j} 与聚类 C ^ k \hat{C}_{k} 之间的权重是它们的 IOU（Yu et al., 2016）。 这种对齐使各分布具有可比性。 我们设置 K = C K=C，使每个分析组都有一个匹配的聚类。 该对齐只是将聚类与群体配对，并不改变哪些回复属于哪个聚类，因此一个内容聚类仍可能混合多个分析组。

paragraphs.en: (2) Preliminaries Let 𝐲 \mathbf{y} and 𝐲 ^ \mathbf{\hat{y}} be the demographic and (aligned) cluster assignment vectors. 𝐃 \mathbf{D} be the dissimilarity matrix. We define: (i) Average Intra-Cluster Dissimilarity ( δ ¯ intra \bar{\delta}_{\text{intra}} ): The mean dissimilarity between pairs within the same cluster and (ii) Average Inter-Cluster Dissimilarity ( δ ¯ inter \bar{\delta}_{\text{inter}} ): The mean dissimilarity between pairs in different clusters.

paragraphs.en: (3) Evaluation Metrics. The four metrics are defined on the two partitions and bounded in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . No single metric constitutes the assessment: they form one profile, and each is read in the context of the others. They are not “higher-is-better” scores: high GMR/DDR supports group-level pattern extraction, low GMR/DDR may reveal cross-group or lens-orthogonal themes, and high DC with low or moderate DP flags response variation and candidate deviant cases for human interpretation. Tab. 17 (Appendix C ) maps signal combinations to next steps.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 评估指标。 这四个指标都定义在两个划分之上，且取值范围在 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 内。 任何单一指标都不构成完整评估：它们共同构成一个画像，且每个指标都需结合其他指标来解读。 它们并非“越高越好”的分数：高 GMR/DDR 支持群体层面的模式提取，低 GMR/DDR 可能揭示跨群体或与透镜正交的主题，而高 DC 伴随低或中等 DP 则标记出响应差异以及供人工解读的候选异常案例。 表 17（附录 C）将信号组合映射到后续步骤。

paragraphs.en: General Pattern / Data Point: General Match Ratio (GMR). It measures the global alignment between the analytical and cluster distributions. A high GMR indicates that the intrinsic structure aligns with the selected analytical lens and may support representative responses for each group; a low GMR suggests that the lens weakly explains response structure or that themes cut across groups.
paragraphs.zh: 通用模式/数据点：通用匹配率（GMR）。 它衡量的是分析分布与聚类分布之间的全局一致性。 高 GMR 表明内在结构与所选分析视角相吻合，并可能支持为每个群组给出具有代表性的回应；低 GMR 则表明该视角对回应结构的解释力较弱，或主题跨越了多个群组。

sents.en: General Pattern / Data Point: General Match Ratio (GMR).
sents.zh: 通用模式/数据点：通用匹配率（GMR）。

sents.en: It measures the global alignment between the analytical and cluster distributions.
sents.zh: 它衡量的是分析分布与聚类分布之间的全局一致性。

sents.en: A high GMR indicates that the intrinsic structure aligns with the selected analytical lens and may support representative responses for each group; a low GMR suggests that the lens weakly explains response structure or that themes cut across groups.
sents.zh: 高 GMR 表明内在结构与所选分析视角相吻合，并可能支持为每个群组给出具有代表性的回应；低 GMR 则表明该视角对回应结构的解释力较弱，或主题跨越了多个群组。

paragraphs.en: GMR = max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − 1 C ​ ‖ n j − 𝐌 j ​ j n j + | n j − n ^ j | n j ‖ 2 ) \displaystyle\text{GMR}=\max\!\left(0,\;1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{C}}\left\|\frac{n_{j}-\mathbf{M}_{jj}}{n_{j}}+\frac{|n_{j}-\hat{n}_{j}|}{n_{j}}\right\|_{2}\right)
paragraphs.zh: GMR = max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − 1 C ​ ‖ n j − 𝐌 j ​ j n j + | n j − n ^ j | n j ‖ 2 ) \displaystyle\text{GMR}=\max\!\left(0,\;1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{C}}\left\|\frac{n_{j}-\mathbf{M}_{jj}}{n_{j}}+\frac{|n_{j}-\hat{n}_{j}|}{n_{j}}\right\|_{2}\right)

paragraphs.en: GMR combines two failure modes of a lens: mismatch , ( n j − 𝐌 j ​ j ) / n j (n_{j}-\mathbf{M}_{jj})/n_{j} , the share of group j j not recovered by its matched cluster, and size distortion , | n j − n ^ j | / n j |n_{j}-\hat{n}_{j}|/n_{j} , which penalizes partitions where one cluster absorbs several groups. The L2 norm scaled by 1 / C 1/\sqrt{C} lets a single poorly recovered group lower GMR more than uniformly small errors. Because GMR counts per-response matches, it indicates whether individual responses can represent their group; errors are normalized within each group, so groups count equally regardless of size, and ARI and NMI are reported alongside it (Tab. 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: GMR 结合了聚类的两种失败模式：失配率（mismatch），即 ( n j − 𝐌 j ​ j ) / n j (n_{j}-\mathbf{M}_{jj})/n_{j}，表示组 j j 中未被其匹配簇恢复的比例；以及规模扭曲（size distortion），即 | n j − n ^ j | / n j |n_{j}-\hat{n}_{j}|/n_{j}，用于惩罚单个簇吸收多个组的划分方式。 经过 1 / C 1/\sqrt{C} 缩放的 L2 范数使得单个恢复效果差的组对 GMR 造成的降低幅度大于均匀分布的小误差。 由于 GMR 按逐个响应统计匹配情况，它能够表明各个响应是否可以代表其所属的组；误差在每个组内部进行归一化，因此各组不论规模大小均被同等计权，同时我们还与 ARI 和 NMI 一并报告该指标（见表 6）。

paragraphs.en: General Pattern / Distribution: Data Distinguishability Ratio (DDR). It measures how much the selected analytical lens separates responses by comparing the average dissimilarity between responses from different groups with that between responses from the same group. High DDR indicates that responses collected from different groups distinctly represent the common feature of that group.
paragraphs.zh: 通用模式/分布：数据可区分度比率（DDR）。 它通过比较来自不同组的响应之间的平均相异度与来自同一组的响应之间的平均相异度，来衡量所选分析视角能在多大程度上区分响应。 高 DDR 表明从不同组收集的响应明显代表了该组的共同特征。

paragraphs.en: Response Mining. QuAD also identifies specific responses for qualitative analysis. These responses, which either challenge expected structures or strongly represent general patterns, are characterized as the top- k k responses with the highest and lowest average dissimilarity δ ¯ ​ ( d i ) \bar{\delta}(d_{i}) to the other responses in their lens group, marking them as candidate unusual or representative members of that group. A response is thus unusual when it departs from the typical position of its group along the research criterion. They are intended for response triage before subsequent human interpretation, not as automatic substitutes for thematic coding.
paragraphs.zh: 回答挖掘。 QuAD 还会识别特定回答以供质性分析。 这些回答要么挑战预期结构，要么强烈代表一般模式，其特征是在各自视角组中与其他回答的平均相异度 δ ¯ ​ ( d i ) \bar{\delta}(d_{i}) 最高和最低的 top- k k 个回答，这使它们成为该组中候选的异常或代表性成员。 因此，当一个回答偏离其所在组在研究标准上的典型位置时，它就是异常的。 这些回答旨在用于后续人工解读之前的回答分诊，而非作为主题编码的自动替代。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate QuAD through controlled experiments on synthetic data (Sec. 4.1 ) and a real-world case study (Sec. 4.2 ). We use “Qwen-max-latest” Yang et al. (2025) as the default model for its stable API access, strong instruction following, and favorable cost-performance over the many LLM calls of dissimilarity extraction; QuAD itself is model-agnostic, and Sec. 4.1.2 checks whether conclusions depend on this default. The same model drives the synthetic-data generation agents (Appendix D.2.1 ); measured token usage, API cost, and results for cheaper model tiers are in Appendix A.6 (Tabs. 8 and 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过在合成数据上的受控实验（第4.1节）和一个真实世界案例研究（第4.2节）来评估QuAD。 我们使用“Qwen-max-latest”（Yang等，2025）作为默认模型。 选择它作为默认模型是因为其稳定的API访问、强大的指令遵循能力，以及在差异提取所需的多次大语言模型调用中良好的性价比；QuAD本身与模型无关，第4.1.2节检验了结论是否依赖于这一默认设置。 同一模型驱动合成数据生成智能体（附录D.2.1）；实测的token用量、API成本以及更便宜模型档位的结果见附录A.6（表8和表9）。

sents.en: We evaluate QuAD through controlled experiments on synthetic data (Sec. 4.1 ) and a real-world case study (Sec. 4.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Datasets in 4 domains (HCI, Finance, Additive Manufacturing, and Medicine) are produced by our Controllable Synthetic Data Generation System (Appendix D ), so ground truth is known for precise evaluation. These experiments check measurement behavior against known ground truth, like unit tests of an instrument; real-data validation is in Sec. 4.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 四个领域（人机交互、金融、增材制造和医学）的数据集由我们的可控合成数据生成系统生成（附录 D），因此真值已知，可用于精确评估。 这些实验针对已知的真值检验测量行为，类似于对仪器的单元测试；真实数据验证见第 4.2 节。

paragraphs.en: A controlled within-subjects study assesses only the human-in-the-loop instruction generation module’s impact on cognitive load and efficiency, not all of QuAD or a full qualitative-analysis interface.
paragraphs.zh: 一项受试者内对照研究仅评估人在回路的指令生成模块对认知负荷和效率的影响，而非 QuAD 的全部或完整的定性分析界面。

paragraphs.en: Experimental Setup. We recruited 20 postgraduate students from diverse domains. Each participant used two systems: (1) our system implementing the adaptation phase described in Sec. 3.1.2 , and (2) a baseline system that employed the same user interface but with agent-assisted features disabled, requiring users to compose instructions manually. Participants wrote dissimilarity-extraction instructions for two distinct questions with both systems. The counterbalanced schedule is in Tab. 18 and per-item statistical comparisons are in Tab. 19 .
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 我们招募了来自不同领域的 20 名研究生。 每位参与者使用两个系统：（1）实现了第 3.1.2 节所述适配阶段的我们的系统；（2）采用相同用户界面但禁用了智能体辅助功能、需要用户手动编写指令的基线系统。 参与者使用两个系统为两个不同的问题编写差异性提取指令。 平衡顺序安排见表 18，逐项统计比较见表 19。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated both systems on Cognitive Load (NASA-TLX) ( Hart and Staveland, 1988 ) and System Usability (details in Appendix D ). We use the standard NASA-TLX for completeness. paragraphs.en: Results and Analysis. As shown in Fig. 4 , participants report lower cognitive load when composing instructions with our framework. It also receives higher ratings on all satisfaction items. Instructions from this study were used in later experiments.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative Comparison on Instruction Quality. Beyond the user study, we also evaluate instruction quality on synthetic datasets by measuring the correlation between extracted and ground-truth dissimilarity scores. The baseline uses the instructions participants directly wrote in the manual condition. Pairwise scores drift in scale across pairs and correlations stay near zero. Scalar projection scores every response on one axis, so direct instructions are already partly calibrated and our gains are smaller.
paragraphs.zh: 指令质量的定量比较。 除用户研究外，我们还在合成数据集上评估指令质量，方法是衡量提取的不相似度分数与真实值之间的相关性。 基线使用参与者在手动条件下直接撰写的指令。 成对分数在不同对之间的量级发生漂移，相关性接近于零。 标量投影将每个响应都投影到一个轴上评分，因此直接指令已经部分得到校准，我们的提升较小。

sents.en: Scalar projection scores every response on one axis, so direct instructions are already partly calibrated and our gains are smaller.
sents.zh: 标量投影将每个响应都投影到一个轴上评分，因此直接指令已经部分得到校准，我们的提升较小。

paragraphs.en: We check robustness at four points of the pipeline: anchor components, dissimilarity source, model family and run, and downstream reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: Adaptive-anchor ablation. On pairwise and scalar-projection synthetic datasets, we disable one of five anchor components at a time and measure correlation with ground truth. By Spearman correlation, the full configuration ranks first in five of the ten model–regime combinations and within the top two in nine, has the highest mean in both regimes (pairwise 0.743 0.743 vs. ≤ 0.726 \leq 0.726 ; scalar 0.776 0.776 vs. ≤ 0.775 \leq 0.775 ), and has the highest worst case ( 0.708 0.708 vs. ≤ 0.659 \leq 0.659 ). Single ablations can win for one model, but none is consistently better, so the full configuration is the most reliable default (Appendix A.1 , Tab. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 自适应锚点消融。 在成对和标量投影合成数据集上，我们每次禁用五个锚点组件中的一个，并测量与真实值的相关性。 按 Spearman 相关系数计算，完整配置在十个模型–情形组合中有五个排名第一，有九个排名前二，在两种情形中均具有最高均值（成对 0.743 0.743 对比 ≤ 0.726 \leq 0.726 ；标量 0.776 0.776 对比 ≤ 0.775 \leq 0.775 ），并具有最高的最差情形（ 0.708 0.708 对比 ≤ 0.659 \leq 0.659 ）。 单一消融在某个模型上可能胜出，但没有一个始终更优，因此完整配置是最可靠的默认选择（附录 A.1，表 2）。

paragraphs.en: We applied QuAD in both small- and large-scale configurations to synthetic datasets with controlled distributional variations. We generated two sets of 15-interviewee datasets (protocol in Appendix D ). In the first set ( Fixed Mean ), the inter-community mean difference was fixed while variance was swept from 1 to 40. In the second set ( Fixed Variance ), variance was fixed at 20 while the mean difference was swept from 5 to 45.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在小型和大规模配置下，将 QuAD 应用于具有受控分布变化的合成数据集。 我们生成了两组各含 15 名受访者的数据集（协议见附录 D）。 在第一组（Fixed Mean）中，社群间均值差保持固定，而方差从 1 到 40 进行扫描。 在第二组（Fixed Variance）中，方差固定为 20，而均值差从 5 到 45 进行扫描。

sents.en: We applied QuAD in both small- and large-scale configurations to synthetic datasets with controlled distributional variations.
sents.zh: 我们在小型和大规模配置下，将 QuAD 应用于具有受控分布变化的合成数据集。

sents.en: We generated two sets of 15-interviewee datasets (protocol in Appendix D ).
sents.zh: 我们生成了两组各含 15 名受访者的数据集（协议见附录 D）。

sents.en: In the first set ( Fixed Mean ), the inter-community mean difference was fixed while variance was swept from 1 to 40.
sents.zh: 在第一组（Fixed Mean）中，社群间均值差保持固定，而方差从 1 到 40 进行扫描。

sents.en: In the second set ( Fixed Variance ), variance was fixed at 20 while the mean difference was swept from 5 to 45.
sents.zh: 在第二组（Fixed Variance）中，方差固定为 20，而均值差从 5 到 45 进行扫描。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 5 , with increasing variance, GMR, DP, and DDR decreased while DC increased; with increasing mean difference, GMR, DP, and DDR increased while DC remained stable. These distinct joint patterns match our design, validating QuAD ’s scoring functions.
paragraphs.zh: 如图5所示，随着方差的增大，GMR、DP和DDR下降，而DC上升；随着均值差的增大，GMR、DP和DDR上升，而DC保持稳定。 这些不同的联合模式与我们的设计相符，验证了QuAD的评分函数。

paragraphs.en: This case study externally validates QuAD on real, human-annotated qualitative data (details in Appendix B ). The Food Choices dataset contains 122 human-written responses to a survey question about eating-habit changes since entering college; grade level is the analytical lens, and QuAD runs in the scalar regime. Each response also carries a pre-existing human label of its eating-habit change (worse, better, same, or unclear). The labels were produced independently of QuAD and withheld from instruction refinement, model selection, and inference, so they serve as an external criterion; comparisons with label classes exclude the three unclear responses ( N = 119 N=119 ). As the instruction encodes the research question, the instruction and the labels target the same construct. The validation tests whether the lens verdict QuAD reaches before coding matches the verdict available after coding, and whether responses sharing a code lie closer.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究在真实的、人工标注的定性数据上对 QuAD 进行了外部验证（详见附录 B）。 Food Choices 数据集包含 122 条针对“进入大学以来饮食习惯变化”这一调查问题的人工撰写回答；年级是分析视角，QuAD 在标量模式下运行。 每条回答还带有一个预先存在的人工标签，标示其饮食习惯变化（变差、变好、不变或不清楚）。 这些标签的生成独立于 QuAD，并且在指令精炼、模型选择和推理过程中被保留未用，因此可作为外部标准；与标签类别的比较排除了三条“不清楚”的回答（N = 119）。 由于指令编码了研究问题，指令与标签指向的是同一构念。 该验证检验的是：QuAD 在编码前依据该视角得出的判断是否与编码后可获得的判断相匹配，以及共享同一编码的回答是否彼此更接近。

paragraphs.en: Dataset-level validation. QuAD reports G ​ M ​ R = 0.39 GMR=0.39 , D ​ D ​ R = 0.02 DDR=0.02 , D ​ C = 0.90 DC=0.90 , and D ​ P = 0.43 DP=0.43 : grade groups barely align with or separate the reconstructed clusters, responses are widely dispersed within clusters, and clusters mix grades. From this joint profile, QuAD judges grade level a weak lens for eating-habit changes, matching its weak association with human labels (Cramér’s V = 0.130 V=0.130 ). Switching the lens on the same responses to eating-habit change flips the profile: DDR rises from 0.02 0.02 to 0.52 0.52 and DP from 0.43 0.43 to 0.75 0.75 , so the verdict tracks the lens (Appendix B.4 ). Partly shuffling these labels lowers DDR monotonically to the grade-level value, and standard association tests on the same scores corroborate the grade verdict (Appendix B.6 ). A direct end-to-end LLM assessment given the same input instead rates grade level as strong and is sensitive to response order, unlike QuAD ’s fixed aggregation rules (Appendix B.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 数据集层面的验证。 QuAD 报告 G ​ M ​ R = 0.39 GMR=0.39、D ​ D ​ R = 0.02 DDR=0.02、D ​ C = 0.90 DC=0.90 和 D ​ P = 0.43 DP=0.43：等级组与重构出的簇几乎不对齐也不分离，响应在簇内广泛分散，且簇中混合了不同等级。 根据这一综合画像，QuAD 判定等级水平是刻画饮食习惯变化的弱透镜，这与其与人工标签的弱相关性一致（Cramér's V = 0.130 V=0.130）。 将透镜切换到同一批关于饮食习惯变化的响应后，画像发生翻转：DDR 从 0.02 0.02 升至 0.52 0.52，DP 从 0.43 0.43 升至 0.75 0.75，因此判定结果随透镜而变（附录 B.4）。 对这些标签进行部分打乱后，DDR 单调下降至等级水平的数值，且对相同分数进行的标准关联性检验也证实了关于等级水平的判定（附录 B.6）。 相比之下，在相同输入下进行直接端到端的大语言模型评估则将等级水平评为强，且对响应顺序敏感，这与 QuAD 固定的聚合规则不同（附录 B.5）。

Within grades, mined responses match the example in Sec. 1 : representative freshman responses describe eating less and more junk food; unusual ones, more fruits, vegetables, and seafood (Appendix B.8.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Independent evaluator validation. After reading the 122 raw responses grouped by grade without the QuAD report, three evaluators reviewed the report and rated its correctness, interpretability, and usefulness for later coding on seven-point scales. All median ratings were 6 (correctness 4–7; interpretability and usefulness 6–7; Appendix B.7 ).

paragraphs.en: We introduced QuAD , a framework for quantitative pre-analysis assessment of qualitative response datasets. A content-aware multi-agent system with interactive instruction generation and adaptive anchors computes task-conditioned dissimilarities; a four-quadrant framework jointly reads how the cluster distribution aligns with or diverges from a researcher-defined analytical lens and how much variation remains within clusters, yielding fitness-for-purpose signals for general patterns and unique insights. Controlled experiments and a human-labeled case study show QuAD complements qualitative coding by quantitatively assessing readiness and also prioritizing responses for human check.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 QuAD，一个用于对定性回复数据集进行定量预分析评估的框架。 一个具备交互式指令生成与自适应锚点的内容感知多智能体系统计算任务条件化的相异度；一个四象限框架同时解读聚类分布与研究者定义的分析视角在多大程度上一致或偏离，以及聚类内部还残留多少变异，从而为一般性模式和独特见解产生适用性信号。 受控实验和一个人工标注的案例研究表明，QuAD 通过定量评估就绪度来补充定性编码，同时还能为人工检查优先排序回复。

sents.en: We introduced QuAD , a framework for quantitative pre-analysis assessment of qualitative response datasets.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 QuAD，一个用于对定性回复数据集进行定量预分析评估的框架。

sents.en: A content-aware multi-agent system with interactive instruction generation and adaptive anchors computes task-conditioned dissimilarities; a four-quadrant framework jointly reads how the cluster distribution aligns with or diverges from a researcher-defined analytical lens and how much variation remains within clusters, yielding fitness-for-purpose signals for general patterns and unique insights.

sents.zh: 受控实验和一个人工标注的案例研究表明，QuAD 通过定量评估就绪度来补充定性编码，同时还能为人工检查优先排序回复。

paragraphs.en: Dependence on the underlying LLM. QuAD inherits the capabilities and stability of its underlying judge. Model updates, decoding settings, and service-side changes can introduce scoring drift; repeated-run and cross-model checks quantify but do not eliminate this source of variation.
paragraphs.zh: 依赖于底层 LLM。 QuAD 继承了其底层评判者（judge）的能力与稳定性。 模型更新、解码设置以及服务端变更都可能引入评分漂移；重复运行与跨模型检查可以量化但无法消除这一变异来源。

sents.zh: 依赖于底层 LLM。

paragraphs.en: Linguistic and cultural bias. LLM judgments may privilege standard dialects, dominant cultural framings, verbosity, or particular writing styles. Such preferences can reduce the visibility of culturally specific meanings and encourage homogenized interpretations. Researchers should inspect the generated instruction, anchor examples, representative responses, and outliers, with particular attention to minority-language and culturally situated responses.
paragraphs.zh: 语言与文化偏差。 大语言模型的评判可能偏向标准方言、主流文化框架、冗长表达或特定写作风格。 这类偏好可能降低文化特定含义的可见度，并助长同质化的解读。 研究者应检查生成的指令、锚定示例、代表性回答和离群回答，并特别关注少数语言及特定文化情境下的回答。

sents.en: Linguistic and cultural bias.
sents.zh: 语言与文化偏差。

sents.en: LLM judgments may privilege standard dialects, dominant cultural framings, verbosity, or particular writing styles.
sents.zh: 大语言模型的评判可能偏向标准方言、主流文化框架、冗长表达或特定写作风格。

sents.zh: 这类偏好可能降低文化特定含义的可见度，并助长同质化的解读。

sents.zh: 研究者应检查生成的指令、锚定示例、代表性回答和离群回答，并特别关注少数语言及特定文化情境下的回答。

paragraphs.en: Information loss under scalar projection. The large-scale regime compresses potentially multidimensional semantic relations onto one task-conditioned axis. This approximation improves efficiency while losing relational detail when dissimilarity is intrinsically multifaceted. The pairwise regime lets the judge compare two responses directly and can retain relations beyond a single axis when the instruction defines them; its O ⁡ ( N 2 ) O(N^{2}) cost makes it best suited to pilot subsets and smaller corpora. Our synthetic pairwise tasks use a latent-score gap as ground truth, so they validate pairwise scoring but not relations beyond a single axis. In the scalar regime, standard association tests on the scores provide a complementary significance check of group separation (Appendix B.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 标量投影下的信息损失。 大规模机制将潜在的多维语义关系压缩到单一的任务条件轴上。 这种近似提升了效率，但当不相似性本质上是多面向的时会丢失关系细节。 成对机制让评审智能体直接比较两个回复，并且当指令定义了这些关系时，可以保留单一轴之外的关系；其 O(N²) 的成本使其最适合用于试点子集和较小的语料库。 我们的合成成对任务以潜在分数差距作为真实标准，因此它们验证的是成对打分，而非单一轴之外的关系。 在标量机制下，对分数进行标准的关联检验可以为群体分离提供一种补充性的显著性检验（附录 B.6）。

paragraphs.en: Metric interpretation and coverage. The four metrics describe how a selected lens relates to response structure; whether this structure is qualitatively meaningful also depends on context, theory, and interpretive aims. Reading a single high score as a complete quality judgment risks metric-washing and may downplay meaningful outliers, so QuAD reports the metrics as one profile to be read together with the mined responses. Default settings, such as K = C K=C , the unweighted DP, and the DC baseline γ \gamma , are listed in Tab. 3 and can be adapted to a study, for example by adding checks for minority coverage or tail behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 指标解读与覆盖范围。 这四个指标描述所选透镜与回答结构之间的关系；这种结构是否具有实质性意义还取决于语境、理论和解释目标。 将单一的高分解读为完整的质量判断会有指标粉饰的风险，并可能淡化有意义的离群值，因此 QuAD 将这些指标作为一个整体画像来呈现，需与挖掘出的回答一起阅读。 默认设置（如 K=C K=C、未加权的 DP 以及 DC 基线的 γ \gamma）列于表 3 中，并可根据研究需要进行调整，例如添加对少数群体覆盖率或尾部行为的检查。

paragraphs.en: Evidence scope. Controlled experiments use synthetic responses with known latent scores, complemented by cross-family generation (Tab. 5 ) and a human-written case study. Real-data validation uses one survey corpus, assessed under eight metadata lenses, the dataset’s own human code, and a graded label-noise series between them (Appendix B.4 ). Since the scoring instruction and the human code address the same research question, this validation tests whether QuAD measures the intended construct on real text. Additional corpora and lenses would further test generality.
paragraphs.zh: 证据范围。 受控实验使用具有已知潜在分数的合成回复，并辅以跨语系生成（表 5）和一个人工撰写的案例研究。 真实数据验证使用一个调查语料库，在八个元数据视角、该数据集自身的人工编码，以及二者之间的分级标签噪声序列下进行评估（附录 B.4）。 由于评分指令与人工编码针对的是同一个研究问题，该验证检验的是 QuAD 是否在真实文本上测量了目标构念。 额外的语料库和视角将进一步检验其普适性。

paragraphs.en: Data and risks. The Food Choices dataset is publicly available on Kaggle and contains no direct identifiers. Using LLMs to assist qualitative analysis may introduce interpretation biases or over-reliance on automated outputs, and sensitive open-ended responses may raise privacy concerns. We recommend human validation, careful data anonymization, and transparent reporting of model-assisted decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 数据与风险。 Food Choices 数据集在 Kaggle 上公开可得，且不包含直接标识符。 使用大语言模型辅助定性分析可能引入解释偏差或对自动化输出的过度依赖，且敏感的开放式回答可能引发隐私问题。 我们建议进行人工验证、仔细的数据匿名化处理，以及对模型辅助决策进行透明报告。

Cursor and its associated generative models, such as GPT and Opus, were used to assist with code writing.

paragraphs.en: This appendix reports the full ablation table (Tab. 2 ) summarized in the robustness checks (Sec. 4.1.2 ). The experiment keeps the data generation and evaluation protocol fixed while disabling individual components of the adaptive anchor updating algorithm (Sec. 3.1.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本附录报告在鲁棒性检查（第4.1.2节）中总结的完整消融实验表（表2）。 该实验在保持数据生成和评估协议不变的情况下，禁用自适应锚点更新算法（第3.1.3节）中的各个单独组件。

sents.en: This appendix reports the full ablation table (Tab. 2 ) summarized in the robustness checks (Sec. 4.1.2 ).
sents.zh: 本附录报告在鲁棒性检查（第4.1.2节）中总结的完整消融实验表（表2）。

sents.en: The experiment keeps the data generation and evaluation protocol fixed while disabling individual components of the adaptive anchor updating algorithm (Sec. 3.1.3 ).
sents.zh: 该实验在保持数据生成和评估协议不变的情况下，禁用自适应锚点更新算法（第3.1.3节）中的各个单独组件。

paragraphs.en: Experimental setting. On four 15-interviewee datasets (small scale) and four 90-interviewee datasets (large scale) from different domains (generated via Appendix D ), we evaluate the full method ( Full ) against variants that each disable one component: disabling in-context examples ( No Example ), disabling adaptive updating ( Fixed Example ), including all responses as candidates ( No Novelty Check ), removing example length limits ( No Pruning ), and using a heuristic for score calculation ( Heuristic Quality ), i.e., the LLM-assigned anchor score is replaced by the mean dissimilarity of the candidate to existing samples. We report Pearson and Spearman correlations between extracted and ground-truth dissimilarity scores. Owing to the number of experiments, each reported value is the average across four randomly selected questions from the four domains.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 在来自不同领域的四个 15 名受访者数据集（小规模）和四个 90 名受访者数据集（大规模）（通过附录 D 生成）上，我们将完整方法（Full）与各禁用一个组件的变体进行对比评估：禁用上下文示例（No Example）、禁用自适应更新（Fixed Example）、将所有响应都作为候选（No Novelty Check）、移除示例长度限制（No Pruning），以及使用启发式方法计算分数（Heuristic Quality），即用候选与现有样本的平均不相似度替代由大语言模型给出的锚点分数。 我们报告提取出的不相似度分数与真实不相似度分数之间的皮尔逊（Pearson）和斯皮尔曼（Spearman）相关性。 由于实验数量较多，每个报告的数值均为四个领域中随机选取的四个问题的平均值。

sents.en: Experimental setting.
sents.zh: 实验设置。

paragraphs.en: The complete adaptive-anchor configuration is consistently among the strongest settings and remains robust when moving from pairwise scoring to scalar projection. By Spearman correlation, it ranks first in five of the ten model and regime combinations and within the top two in nine, while Heuristic Quality, the most frequent runner-up, reaches the top two four times. It also has the highest mean Spearman correlation in both regimes (pairwise 0.743 0.743 , next Fixed Example 0.726 0.726 ; scalar 0.776 0.776 , next No Pruning 0.775 0.775 ) and, across the ten settings, the highest minimum ( 0.708 0.708 , next Fixed Example 0.659 0.659 ). Fixed examples or simplified heuristics can perform well for a particular model and scale, but no ablated variant is consistently better. The complete configuration is therefore the most reliable default across the tested settings; the scalar-regime margin in mean is small, and ranks and means summarize relative performance and are not a significance test.

paragraphs.en: This section clarifies the quantities used by QuAD (Tab. 3 ). The quantities are fixed by the study design, the LLM scoring rubric, the number of groups, or computational constraints, and are not tuned on validation data. Empirical values enter only where estimation regimes differ in variance: DC uses λ = 1.2 \lambda=1.2 for pairwise scoring, whose estimates vary more, and λ = 0.8 \lambda=0.8 for scalar projection, whose distances are compressed. Because λ \lambda divides DC uniformly, changing it shifts the level of DC but does not reverse its ordering across lenses with the same C C ; e.g., the case-study DC of 0.90 0.90 becomes 0.72 0.72 at λ = 1.0 \lambda=1.0 and 0.60 0.60 at λ = 1.2 \lambda=1.2 . λ \lambda is an empirical normalization convention, not a validated cut-off for reading DC as high or low.
paragraphs.zh: 本节澄清 QuAD 所使用的各个数量（表 3）。 这些数量由研究设计、LLM 评分标准、分组数量或计算约束所固定，并未在验证数据上进行调优。 经验值仅在估计机制的方差不同之处引入：DC 在成对评分中使用 λ = 1.2，因为其估计值波动更大；在标量投影中使用 λ = 0.8，因为其距离被压缩。 由于 λ 对 DC 进行统一缩放，改变它只会移动 DC 的水平，而不会改变在同一 C 下各镜头（lens）之间的排序；例如，案例研究的 DC 为 0.90 时，在 λ = 1.0 下变为 0.72，在 λ = 1.2 下变为 0.60。λ 是一种经验性的归一化约定，而不是将 DC 解读为高或低的经验证阈值。

paragraphs.en: Question and rationale. A measurement framework should produce stable response geometry and dataset-level metrics when its inputs and evaluation instruction are held fixed. We therefore test variation across repeated runs and model families.
paragraphs.zh: 问题与理由。 一个测量框架在输入和评估指令保持固定的情况下，应能产生稳定的响应几何结构与数据集级指标。 因此，我们检验重复运行和不同模型家族之间的差异。

sents.en: Question and rationale.
sents.zh: 问题与理由。

sents.en: A measurement framework should produce stable response geometry and dataset-level metrics when its inputs and evaluation instruction are held fixed.
sents.zh: 一个测量框架在输入和评估指令保持固定的情况下，应能产生稳定的响应几何结构与数据集级指标。

sents.en: We therefore test variation across repeated runs and model families.
sents.zh: 因此，我们检验重复运行和不同模型家族之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. On a fixed slice of the controlled synthetic data, qwen-max and deepseek-v3 each perform three independent runs with identical inputs and prompts; clustering randomness is fixed. We report rank agreement between the resulting dissimilarity structures and the mean and standard deviation of the four assessment metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 在受控合成数据的一个固定切片上，qwen-max 和 deepseek-v3 各自在相同输入和提示下进行三次独立运行；聚类随机性被固定。 我们报告所得相异性结构与四项评估指标的平均值和标准差之间的排序一致性。

sents.en: Protocol.
sents.zh: 协议。

sents.en: On a fixed slice of the controlled synthetic data, qwen-max and deepseek-v3 each perform three independent runs with identical inputs and prompts; clustering randomness is fixed.
sents.zh: 在受控合成数据的一个固定切片上，qwen-max 和 deepseek-v3 各自在相同输入和提示下进行三次独立运行；聚类随机性被固定。

sents.en: We report rank agreement between the resulting dissimilarity structures and the mean and standard deviation of the four assessment metrics.
sents.zh: 我们报告所得相异性结构与四项评估指标的平均值和标准差之间的排序一致性。

paragraphs.en: Results. In Tab. 7 , within-model distance correlations are 0.80 and 0.94, and cross-model agreement is 0.87. The largest observed metric standard deviation is 0.050. These results show moderate-to-high rank agreement and limited metric variation in the tested slice. Metric levels differ between the two models, so these results support repeatability within a model, not interchangeability of absolute metric values across models.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 在表 7 中，模型内距离相关性为 0.80 和 0.94，跨模型一致性为 0.87。 观测到的最大指标标准差为 0.050。 这些结果表明，在被测试的切片上，排序一致性为中等到较高，且指标变化有限。 两个模型之间的指标水平不同，因此这些结果支持模型内的可重复性，而非绝对指标值在模型之间的可互换性。

sents.en: Results.
sents.zh: 结果。

sents.zh: 在表 7 中，模型内距离相关性为 0.80 和 0.94，跨模型一致性为 0.87。

sents.en: The largest observed metric standard deviation is 0.050.

sents.zh: 这些结果表明，在被测试的切片上，排序一致性为中等到较高，且指标变化有限。

paragraphs.en: Question and rationale. We evaluate each major pipeline stage using a comparison matched to its function to examine the contribution of each component. These checks separately examine task-specific instruction generation, adaptive-anchor maintenance, semantic representation, and downstream distribution reconstruction. A final real-label comparison tests whether the resulting response geometry transfers beyond synthetic ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: 问题与依据。 我们使用与其功能相匹配的对比方法来评估流水线的每个主要阶段，以考察每个组件的贡献。 这些检查分别考察任务特定的指令生成、自适应锚点维护、语义表示以及下游分布重建。 最终的真实标签对比检验所得到的响应几何结构能否迁移到合成基准之外。

paragraphs.en: Together, these comparisons provide stage-specific evidence: generated instructions and adaptive anchors support task-conditioned dissimilarity extraction, generic embeddings provide a weaker criterion-specific signal, reconstruction remains robust across fixed- K K clustering choices, and the resulting response geometry transfers to an independently labeled real-world dataset.

paragraphs.en: Validation logic. We derive three testable predictions from the system outputs. First, QuAD reports weak alignment between grade level and the reconstructed response structure. If this lens-level assessment is meaningful, grade should also show weak association with the independently assigned thematic labels. Second, if QuAD distances capture task-conditioned thematic differences, responses with different human labels should be farther apart than responses sharing the same label. Third, if the resulting response geometry supports coding-oriented triage, nearest-neighbor retrieval should produce more label-consistent neighborhoods than random retrieval and a lexical TF–IDF baseline. These predictions evaluate the dataset-level conclusion, pair-level distances, and retrieval behavior using the same independent criterion. Because the instruction and the labels target the same construct, these checks test criterion validity, i.e., whether the instruction-conditioned measurement tracks the intended construct on real text; they do not test theme discovery. TF–IDF and generic embeddings do not see the criterion, and the direct LLM sees the research question but not the refined rubric. These comparisons therefore show the value of criterion-conditioned scoring over generic similarity; standard tests on the same QuAD scores are reported in Appendix B.6 . Operationalization. For the lens-level check, Cramér’s V V summarizes the association between grade and thematic label over all 122 responses. For the pair-level check, the three unclear responses are excluded, leaving ( 119 2 ) = 7,021 \binom{119}{2}=7{,}021 pairs; we compare the mean and median distances of same- and different-label pairs, which share responses and are not treated as independent observations. For the retrieval check, label-mismatch AUC treats a different-label pair as the positive class and response distance as the prediction score. Top- k k purity measures the macro-averaged proportion of same-label responses among each query’s k k nearest neighbors, excluding the query itself.
paragraphs.zh: 验证逻辑。 我们从系统输出中推导出三个可检验的预测。 首先，QuAD 报告年级水平与重构的回应结构之间的弱对齐。 如果这一透镜层面的评估是有意义的，那么年级也应与独立分配的主题标签呈现弱关联。 其次，如果 QuAD 距离捕捉到由任务条件引发的主题差异，那么具有不同人工标签的回应之间的距离应大于共享相同标签的回应之间的距离。 第三，如果由此形成的回应几何结构支持面向编码的分流，那么最近邻检索应产生比随机检索和词法 TF–IDF 基线更多标签一致的邻域。 这些预测使用同一个独立标准来评估数据集层面的结论、配对层面的距离以及检索行为。 由于指令与标签指向同一个构念，这些检验考察的是效标效度，即由指令条件化的测量是否在真实文本上追踪了目标构念；它们并不检验主题发现。 TF–IDF 和通用嵌入看不到该效标，直接使用的大语言模型看到了研究问题但看不到精炼的评分规则。 因此，这些比较显示了效标条件化评分相对于通用相似度的价值；对同一 QuAD 分数的标准检验见附录 B.6。操作化。 对于透镜层面的检验，Cramér's V 汇总了全部 122 条回应中年级与主题标签之间的关联。 对于配对层面的检验，剔除三条不清晰的回应后，剩下 \binom{119}{2}=7,021 个配对；我们比较相同标签与不同标签配对的平均距离和中位距离，这些配对共享回应，因此不被视为独立观测。 对于检索检验，标签不匹配 AUC 将不同标签的配对视为正类，将回应距离作为预测分数。 Top-k 纯度衡量每条查询的 k 个最近邻（不含查询本身）中相同标签回应所占比例的宏平均。

sents.en: Validation logic.
sents.zh: 验证逻辑。

sents.en: We derive three testable predictions from the system outputs.
sents.zh: 我们从系统输出中推导出三个可检验的预测。

sents.en: First, QuAD reports weak alignment between grade level and the reconstructed response structure.
sents.zh: 首先，QuAD 报告年级水平与重构的回应结构之间的弱对齐。

sents.en: If this lens-level assessment is meaningful, grade should also show weak association with the independently assigned thematic labels.
sents.zh: 如果这一透镜层面的评估是有意义的，那么年级也应与独立分配的主题标签呈现弱关联。

sents.en: Second, if QuAD distances capture task-conditioned thematic differences, responses with different human labels should be farther apart than responses sharing the same label.
sents.zh: 其次，如果 QuAD 距离捕捉到由任务条件引发的主题差异，那么具有不同人工标签的回应之间的距离应大于共享相同标签的回应之间的距离。

sents.en: Third, if the resulting response geometry supports coding-oriented triage, nearest-neighbor retrieval should produce more label-consistent neighborhoods than random retrieval and a lexical TF–IDF baseline.
sents.zh: 第三，如果由此形成的回应几何结构支持面向编码的分流，那么最近邻检索应产生比随机检索和词法 TF–IDF 基线更多标签一致的邻域。

sents.en: These predictions evaluate the dataset-level conclusion, pair-level distances, and retrieval behavior using the same independent criterion.
sents.zh: 这些预测使用同一个独立标准来评估数据集层面的结论、配对层面的距离以及检索行为。

sents.en: Because the instruction and the labels target the same construct, these checks test criterion validity, i.e., whether the instruction-conditioned measurement tracks the intended construct on real text; they do not test theme discovery.
sents.zh: 由于指令与标签指向同一个构念，这些检验考察的是效标效度，即由指令条件化的测量是否在真实文本上追踪了目标构念；它们并不检验主题发现。

sents.en: TF–IDF and generic embeddings do not see the criterion, and the direct LLM sees the research question but not the refined rubric.
sents.zh: TF–IDF 和通用嵌入看不到该效标，直接使用的大语言模型看到了研究问题但看不到精炼的评分规则。

sents.en: These comparisons therefore show the value of criterion-conditioned scoring over generic similarity; standard tests on the same QuAD scores are reported in Appendix B.6 . Operationalization.

sents.en: For the lens-level check, Cramér’s V V summarizes the association between grade and thematic label over all 122 responses.
sents.zh: 对于透镜层面的检验，Cramér's V 汇总了全部 122 条回应中年级与主题标签之间的关联。

sents.en: For the pair-level check, the three unclear responses are excluded, leaving ( 119 2 ) = 7,021 \binom{119}{2}=7{,}021 pairs; we compare the mean and median distances of same- and different-label pairs, which share responses and are not treated as independent observations.
sents.zh: 对于配对层面的检验，剔除三条不清晰的回应后，剩下 \binom{119}{2}=7,021 个配对；我们比较相同标签与不同标签配对的平均距离和中位距离，这些配对共享回应，因此不被视为独立观测。

sents.en: For the retrieval check, label-mismatch AUC treats a different-label pair as the positive class and response distance as the prediction score.
sents.zh: 对于检索检验，标签不匹配 AUC 将不同标签的配对视为正类，将回应距离作为预测分数。

sents.en: Top- k k purity measures the macro-averaged proportion of same-label responses among each query’s k k nearest neighbors, excluding the query itself.
sents.zh: Top-k 纯度衡量每条查询的 k 个最近邻（不含查询本身）中相同标签回应所占比例的宏平均。

paragraphs.en: Results and interpretation. All three predicted patterns are observed. Tab. 10 reports the association and pair-level results. Grade and thematic label show weak association ( V = 0.130 V=0.130 ), consistent with QuAD ’s conclusion that grade is a weak analytical lens. Different-label pairs have a mean distance of 30.38, compared with 14.61 for same-label pairs, yielding a gap of 15.77. Tab. 11 reports the retrieval results. QuAD achieves a label-mismatch AUC of 0.749 and top-3/top-5 purities of 0.742/0.694, compared with 0.551 and 0.650/0.619 for TF–IDF and 0.500 and 0.489/0.489 for random retrieval; the Qwen3-Embed and Direct LLM rows and the fine-code AUC are discussed in Appendix B.5 . QuAD is highest on both AUCs, whereas Qwen3-Embed has slightly higher neighbour purity, so the advantage of QuAD lies in criterion-specific discrimination rather than in generic neighbourhood structure. Agreement with the fine code is lower (AUC 0.629), as expected when responses with the same score reflect different mechanisms, such as cost or time pressure, which a single scoring axis does not separate. Together, these results show that the instruction-conditioned measurement tracks the intended construct on real text, and that QuAD ’s lens-level conclusion agrees with the independent labels; they do not show theme discovery beyond the instruction. The independent-evaluator study complements these label-based checks by examining agreement with qualitative judgments and perceived usefulness for subsequent coding.
paragraphs.zh: 结果与解释。 三种预测模式均被观察到。 表 10 报告了关联性与配对层面的结果。 年级与主题标签呈现弱关联（ V = 0.130 V=0.130 ），这与 QuAD 的结论一致，即年级是一个较弱的分析视角。 不同标签的配对平均距离为 30.38，而相同标签的配对为 14.61，差距为 15.77。 表 11 报告了检索结果。 QuAD 的标签不匹配 AUC 为 0.749，top-3/top-5 纯度分别为 0.742/0.694，相比之下 TF–IDF 为 0.551 和 0.650/0.619，随机检索为 0.500 和 0.489/0.489；Qwen3-Embed 与 Direct LLM 行以及细码 AUC 在附录 B.5 中讨论。 QuAD 在两个 AUC 上均为最高，而 Qwen3-Embed 的邻近纯度略高，因此 QuAD 的优势在于针对特定准则的判别能力，而非通用邻域结构。 与细码的一致性较低（AUC 0.629），这是可以预期的，因为具有相同得分的回答可能反映不同机制，例如成本或时间压力，而单一评分轴无法将其区分开。 总而言之，这些结果表明基于指令条件化的测量在真实文本上追踪了预期的构念，且 QuAD 的视角层面结论与独立标签一致；它们并未展示超越指令的主题发现。 独立评估者研究通过考察与定性判断的一致性以及对后续编码的感知有用性，补充了这些基于标签的检验。

paragraphs.en: Question and rationale. The case study reports one lens, grade level, which QuAD judges weak. A weak verdict is informative only if the same instrument gives a different reading when the lens is strong. We therefore keep the responses and the QuAD dissimilarity matrix fixed and switch the lens from grade level to eating-habit change, i.e., the dataset’s own human code (worse / better / same; N = 119 N=119 , unclear excluded). By construction, this lens follows the content of the responses, so it serves as a known-strong reference. In the scalar regime the dissimilarity matrix does not depend on the lens, so no additional LLM calls are needed. The four metrics are recomputed with K = C K=C and averaged over 20 reconstruction runs. Because the two lenses also differ in sample size and group count (122/4 vs. 119/3), DDR, which does not depend on the reconstruction, is the most directly comparable metric, whereas DC is normalized by C C and is not compared across the two lenses; the graded series below holds N N and C C fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 问题与依据。 该案例研究报告了单一视角，即年级水平，而 QuAD 判定其为弱。 只有当同一工具在视角较强时给出不同的读数，弱判定才有参考价值。 因此，我们保持响应和 QuAD 相异度矩阵不变，将视角从年级水平切换为饮食习惯变化，即数据集自身的人工编码（变差 / 变好 / 不变；N = 119 N=119，不清楚的已排除）。 从构造上看，该视角遵循响应的内容，因此它可作为已知强视角的参照。 在标量机制下，相异度矩阵不依赖于视角，因此无需额外的 LLM 调用。 四个指标以 K = C K=C 重新计算，并在 20 次重构运行上取平均。 由于两个视角在样本量和组数上也不同（122/4 对 119/3），不依赖于重构的 DDR 是最可直接比较的指标，而 DC 由 C C 归一化，因此不在两个视角之间进行比较；下文的分级系列保持 N N 和 C C 不变。

paragraphs.en: Results. Switching the lens changes the reading in the expected direction (Tab. 12 ). The clearest change is in group separability: DDR rises from 0.02 0.02 , where grade groups are barely distinguishable, to 0.52 0.52 , where between-group dissimilarity is about twice the within-group dissimilarity. DP rises from 0.43 0.43 to 0.75 0.75 , so the reconstructed clusters move from mixed grades to being dominated by a single eating-change group. DC is lower under eating-habit change ( 0.72 0.72 vs. 0.90 0.90 ), but its normalizer depends on C C , which differs between the two lenses, so we do not attribute this difference to the lens. GMR increases moderately, from 0.39 0.39 to 0.53 0.53 . Under grade level, the signals match the second row of Tab. 17 (low GMR/DP/DDR, high DC: revise the lens or code cross-group themes). Under eating-habit change, they match the first row (high GMR/DP/DDR: compare groups and read representative responses first). Both readings agree with the external criterion: grade level is barely associated with the human code ( V = 0.130 V=0.130 ), whereas the eating-change lens is the human code itself. The weak verdict in the case study therefore reflects the lens, not an instrument that reports every lens as weak.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 更换透镜后，各项读数按预期方向变化（表 12）。 最明显的变化体现在组间可分性上：DDR 从 0.02（此时年级组几乎无法区分）上升到 0.52（此时组间相异度约为组内相异度的两倍）。 DP 从 0.43 上升到 0.75，因此重构出的聚类从混合年级转变为由单一饮食变化组主导。 在饮食习惯变化视角下 DC 更低（0.72 对 0.90），但其归一化因子依赖于 C，而两种透镜下的 C 不同，因此我们不将这一差异归因于透镜。 GMR 从 0.39 适度上升至 0.53。 在年级水平下，各信号与表 17 的第二行相符（GMR/DP/DDR 低、DC 高：应修订透镜或对跨组主题进行编码）。 在饮食变化视角下，各信号与第一行相符（GMR/DP/DDR 高：应比较各组并优先阅读代表性回答）。 两种读数均与外部准则一致：年级水平与人工编码几乎无关（V = 0.130），而饮食变化透镜本身就是人工编码。 因此，案例研究中的弱判定反映的是透镜本身，而非该工具将任何透镜都判为弱。

paragraphs.en: Graded lens informativeness. The eating-habit-change lens is the human code itself, so it is an upper endpoint rather than evidence that QuAD separates informative from uninformative lenses. To cover intermediate cases, we keep this lens but randomly reassign the group labels of a fraction p p of responses (20 seeds per p p ), which lowers the information the lens carries about response content from full ( p = 0 p=0 ) to none ( p = 1 p=1 ). The dissimilarity matrix is unchanged, so no LLM calls are needed; metrics use the formulas of Sec. 3.2 with K = C K=C . Tab. 13 shows that DDR decreases monotonically from 0.52 0.52 to 0.02 0.02 , the grade-level value, and follows the same course as the Kruskal–Wallis effect size ε 2 \varepsilon^{2} on the same scores. DP decreases until it reaches the level of the majority-group share ( 0.63 0.63 ), a descriptive reference rather than an exact chance level; the fully permuted lens ( p = 1 p=1 , 0.64 0.64 ) gives the permutation reference for DP, which the unpermuted lens ( 0.76 0.76 ) exceeds. DC stays constant across p p , since the clusters and C C are fixed and DC does not use the lens labels. Because this perturbation changes only the lens–content association, it isolates the lens-dependent readings; QuAD thus tracks how informative a lens is rather than only its two endpoints; eight further metadata lenses are compared with standard tests in Appendix B.6 .

paragraphs.en: Question and rationale. A natural alternative to QuAD is to give an LLM the same input and ask for the same output directly. We test whether this end-to-end shortcut matches QuAD ’s lens verdict, response triage, and response structure.
paragraphs.zh: 问题与理由。 QuAD 的一个自然替代方案是直接让大语言模型接收相同的输入并要求其直接给出相同的输出。 我们测试这种端到端的捷径是否能与 QuAD 的透镜判定、响应分诊以及响应结构相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. We use nine lenses: the eating-habit-change lens of Appendix B.4 and eight survey variables (grade level, gender, living situation, current diet, self-rated health, sports, cooking frequency, and self-perceived weight; codebook categories, groups with fewer than five responses dropped). Seven of the eight have no significant association with the human code ( χ 2 \chi^{2} p ≥ 0.06 p\geq 0.06 ), and current diet has a moderate one ( V = 0.25 V=0.25 ). For each lens, qwen-max (temperature 0 0 , JSON mode) receives the research question and all responses with their IDs and lens groups. It returns (i) a 1–7 lens-usefulness rating and verdict, (ii) three representative and three unusual responses per group, and (iii) a content-only partition of all responses into K = C K=C clusters. Each lens is run three times with a different response order (seeds fixed). Outputs failing schema checks are re-requested up to twice; format-only normalisation (e.g., ID lists returned as strings) is applied, and residual errors are counted as misses (38 out-of-group triage IDs and 4 unassigned responses over 26 runs). One of the 27 runs (current diet) failed after retries and is excluded. Response triage is scored with a label-based proxy: a representative pick is a hit if its human code equals the group’s majority code, and an unusual pick is a hit if it does not. The QuAD and Qwen3-Embed picks use the lowest and highest within-group mean distances. For all methods, the four non-substantive answers (two “none”, one “Nun”, one “None really”) are excluded from the picks and from the random baseline, as in the mined-response lists (Appendix B.8.3 ). Partitions are compared with both human codes by ARI/NMI.
paragraphs.zh: 方案。 我们使用九个视角：附录 B.4 的饮食习惯改变视角，以及八个调查变量（年级、性别、居住情况、当前饮食、自评健康、运动、做饭频率和自我感知体重；采用编码簿类别，剔除回答数少于五人的组）。 八个变量中有七个与人工编码无显著关联（χ² p ≥ 0.06），而当前饮食存在中等程度的关联（V = 0.25）。 对于每个视角，qwen-max（温度为 0，JSON 模式）会接收研究问题以及带有 ID 和视角分组的所有回答。 它返回：(i) 1–7 分的视角有用性评分及判定结论；(ii) 每组三个代表性回答和三个不寻常回答；(iii) 将所有回答按内容划分为 K = C 个聚类的划分结果。 每个视角以不同的回答顺序运行三次（随机种子固定）。 未通过模式检查的输出最多重新请求两次；仅做格式上的规范化（例如将作为字符串返回的 ID 列表进行转换），剩余的错误计为失误（在 26 次运行中共有 38 个超出组范围的分诊 ID 和 4 个未分配的回答）。 27 次运行中的一次（当前饮食）在重试后失败，因此被排除。 回答分诊采用基于标签的代理指标评分：如果代表性回答的人工编码等于该组的多数编码，则视为命中；如果不寻常回答的人工编码不等于该组的多数编码，则视为命中。 QuAD 和 Qwen3-Embed 的选取分别采用组内平均距离最低和最高的回答。 与挖掘回答列表一致（附录 B.8.3），对于所有方法，四个无实质内容的回答（两个“无”、一个“Nun”、一个“实在没有”）均从选取结果和随机基线中排除。 划分结果通过 ARI/NMI 与两套人工编码进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Results. Tab. 14 summarizes the comparison. The direct LLM does not provide a reliable pre-analysis signal. (i) Lens verdict. Its ratings stay within a narrow band of 4–5 for every metadata lens. Grade level is rated 5 and labelled “strong” in all three runs, contrary to the external criterion ( V = 0.13 V=0.13 ), and the eating-habit-change lens receives only 6. A one-point gap thus separates the two lenses, for which QuAD reports clearly different joint profiles (Tab. 12 ). Across the seven metadata lenses without a significant association with the human code, the LLM labels the lens “strong” in 9 of 21 runs. (ii) Response triage. The LLM’s unusual picks reach a proxy hit rate of 0.47 0.47 and its representative picks 0.63 0.63 , the latter below the random level ( 0.66 0.66 ). QuAD reaches 0.82 0.82 and 0.81 0.81 . Qwen3-Embed matches QuAD on representative picks ( 0.80 0.80 ) but its unusual picks reach only 0.29 0.29 . (iii) Response structure. The LLM’s content partitions agree less with the human codes (ARI 0.11 0.11 / 0.08 0.08 ) than QuAD reconstructions (ARI 0.30 0.30 / 0.11 0.11 ), and the pair-level mismatch AUC is 0.613 0.613 versus 0.749 0.749 (Tab. 11 ). (iv) Order sensitivity. Reordering the same responses changes most of the LLM’s selections (mean top-3 Jaccard 0.12 0.12 ) and partitions (mean pairwise ARI 0.37 0.37 ). QuAD computes the report from a fixed distance matrix, so presenting the responses in a different order to this stage leaves its picks unchanged; this shows that the reporting stage is deterministic, not that scoring with adaptive anchors is order-invariant. Qwen3-Embed attains higher neighbour purity than QuAD (Tab. 11 ) but near-zero partition agreement, so generic semantic similarity alone does not recover the criterion-specific structure.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 表 14 总结了对比结果。 直接使用 LLM 无法提供可靠的事前分析信号。(i) Lens 判定。 对于每个元数据 lens，其评分始终停留在 4–5 的狭窄区间内。 三次运行中 grade level lens 均被评为 5 分并标注为“强”（strong），与外部标准相悖（ V = 0.13 V=0.13 ），而 eating-habit-change lens 仅得 6 分。 因此这两个 lens 之间仅有一分的差距，而 QuAD 报告的联合特征却明显不同（表 12 ）。 在与人工编码无显著关联的七个元数据 lens 中，LLM 在 21 次运行中有 9 次将该 lens 标注为“强”。(ii) 响应分诊。 LLM 的 unusual 选取达到 0.47 0.47 的代理命中率，其 representative 选取为 0.63 0.63 ，后者低于随机水平（ 0.66 0.66 ）。 QuAD 分别达到 0.82 0.82 和 0.81 0.81 。 Qwen3-Embed 在 representative 选取上与 QuAD 相当（ 0.80 0.80 ），但其 unusual 选取仅达到 0.29 0.29 。 (iii) 响应结构。 LLM 的内容划分与人工编码的一致性（ARI 0.11 0.11 / 0.08 0.08 ）低于 QuAD 重构结果（ARI 0.30 0.30 / 0.11 0.11 ），且配对层面的失配 AUC 为 0.613 0.613 ，对比之下 QuAD 为 0.749 0.749 （表 11 ）。(iv) 顺序敏感性。 对相同响应重新排序会改变 LLM 的大部分选取结果（平均 top-3 Jaccard 0.12 0.12 ）和划分结果（平均两两 ARI 0.37 0.37 ）。 QuAD 从固定的距离矩阵计算报告，因此向该阶段以不同顺序呈现响应不会改变其选取结果；这说明报告阶段是确定性的，而非使用自适应锚点进行评分具有顺序不变性。 Qwen3-Embed 的邻居纯度高于 QuAD（表 11 ），但划分一致性接近于零，因此仅靠通用语义相似度无法恢复特定于标准的结构。

paragraphs.en: Scope and cost. The direct LLM sees the lens groups, which can bias its lens verdict; the prompt instructs it to ignore groups when clustering. It receives the research question but not the refined case-study rubric, so the comparison contrasts end-to-end judgment with QuAD ’s per-response scoring and fixed aggregation rather than isolating a single component. The matched variant with the same final instruction, fixed examples, and per-response scoring is the Fixed Example ablation on the synthetic data (Tab. 2 ). The proxy triage score uses only the coarse code and is not a substitute for the evaluator study (Appendix B.7 ). Because QuAD scores follow the same construct as this code, the proxy checks that picks are consistent with the criterion, not that they are worth reading. The 53 direct-LLM calls (including retries) used 256,444 tokens; the Qwen3 embeddings used 1,714 tokens; the strong-lens analysis (Appendix B.4 ) required no LLM calls.

paragraphs.en: Question and rationale. Standard association tests between these scores and lens groups can thus be applied directly. If DDR, the group-separation component of the profile, measures separation as intended, it should agree with these tests on the same scores; we use them as a convergent-validity check of DDR, and Result (iii) shows what the full profile adds beyond a test.

paragraphs.en: Results. (i) Same verdict at both ends. No test detects a grade effect ( p ≥ 0.27 p\geq 0.27 ; DDR p = 0.38 p=0.38 ), and all detect the human-code effect ( p ≤ 0.002 p\leq 0.002 ; Tab. 15 ). (ii) Detection versus effect size. KW and PERMANOVA flag current diet ( p = 0.031 p=0.031 and 0.023 0.023 ), the metadata lens most associated with the human code ( V ∗ = 0.25 V^{\ast}=0.25 ), and KW also flags sports, whereas the DDR permutation test does not reach p < 0.05 p<0.05 for any metadata lens. A test answers whether group scores differ detectably; DDR, like ε 2 \varepsilon^{2} , is an effect size that states how much of the dissimilarity structure the lens explains. On both effect sizes these two lenses are small ( ε 2 ≤ 0.04 \varepsilon^{2}\leq 0.04 , DDR = 0.03 =0.03 ), against 0.45 0.45 and 0.52 0.52 for the human code, so their group differences are detectable but explain little of the response structure. We therefore read DDR as an effect size reported alongside the test rather than as a competing test. (iii) What the profile adds beyond a test. A test returns one lens-level decision; for grade level, no detectable effect ( p ≥ 0.27 p\geq 0.27 ). A non-significant test is consistent both with homogeneous responses and with varied responses organized along another axis, and it does not indicate a next step. The profile on the same responses separates these cases (Tab. 12 ): high DC ( 0.90 0.90 ) shows that the responses are not homogeneous, while low DP ( 0.43 0.43 ), GMR ( 0.39 0.39 ), and DDR ( 0.02 0.02 ) show that the clusters mix grades and do not follow the grade groups. This joint reading points to themes that cut across grades and corresponds to the second row of Tab. 17 (revise the lens or code cross-group themes; read unusual responses first), whereas the human-code profile corresponds to the first row (compare groups; read representative responses first). Thus GMR and DDR grade how far the lens explains response structure rather than only whether groups differ, and DP and DC describe group mixing and remaining within-cluster variation, which a lens-level test does not address. In the controlled distribution-shift experiment, the four metrics also respond in different patterns to different structural changes (Fig. 5 ). In the scalar regime, standard tests can be reported alongside the profile; in the pairwise regime no single score exists, so only distance-based tests such as PERMANOVA on 𝐃 \mathbf{D} remain applicable.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 (i) 两端判定一致。 没有检验检测到年级效应（p≥0.27；DDR p=0.38），所有检验都检测到人工编码效应（p≤0.002；表 15）。 (ii) 检测与效应量。 KW 和 PERMANOVA 标记出当前饮食（p=0.031 和 0.023），这是与人工编码关联最强的元数据透镜（V*=0.25），KW 还标记出体育，而 DDR 置换检验对任何元数据透镜都未达到 p<0.05。 检验回答的是组间得分差异是否可被检测到；而 DDR 与 ε² 一样，是一种效应量，说明该透镜解释了多大比例的相异性结构。 在两种效应量上，这两个透镜都很小（ε²≤0.04，DDR=0.03），而人工编码分别为 0.45 和 0.52，因此它们的组间差异虽可被检测到，但对响应结构的解释却很少。 因此，我们将 DDR 解读为与检验一同报告的效应量，而不是与之竞争的检验。 (iii) 剖析在检验之外的补充。 检验只返回一个透镜层面的判定；就年级而言，没有可检测到的效应（p≥0.27）。 不显著的检验既可能对应同质的响应，也可能对应沿其他轴组织的异质响应，而且它不指示下一步该做什么。 而对相同响应的剖析则区分了这些情形（表 12）：高 DC（0.90）表明响应并非同质，而低 DP（0.43）、GMR（0.39）和 DDR（0.02）表明聚类混合了年级、并未跟随年级分组。 这种联合解读指向贯穿各年级的主题，对应表 17 的第二行（修订透镜或对跨组主题编码；先阅读异常响应），而人工编码剖析对应第一行（比较各组；先阅读代表性响应）。 因此，GMR 和 DDR 衡量的是透镜对响应结构的解释程度，而不仅仅是各组是否不同；DP 和 DC 描述的是组的混合情况与簇内剩余变异，这些都不是透镜层面的检验所能处理的。 在受控的分布偏移实验中，这四个指标对不同结构变化也表现出不同的响应模式（图 5）。 在标量情形下，可以在剖析之外一并报告标准检验；在成对情形下不存在单一得分，因此只剩下基于距离的检验（如对 𝐃 施加的 PERMANOVA）仍然适用。

paragraphs.en: Participants. We recruited three evaluators through a social media advertisement; most had backgrounds in human–computer interaction or human-centered research. All evaluators provided informed consent before participating and received USD 10 as compensation. Names were used only to resume sessions and arrange compensation, and were replaced by anonymous identifiers (E1–E3) in all analyses.

paragraphs.en: Step 1: blinded familiarization. Evaluators received the research question and all 122 raw responses grouped by grade; the QuAD report and thematic labels remained hidden. For each grade, the responses were displayed in full by default, and evaluators confirmed having viewed them before proceeding. This step also contained response-level typical/unusual judgments and a lens-helpfulness rating. In post-study debriefing, evaluators reported that the purpose of these judgments was unclear to them; we therefore treat Step 1 as familiarization with the data and do not analyze its judgments. This decision was made after data collection.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤 1：盲测熟悉阶段。 评估者收到研究问题以及按等级分组的全部 122 条原始回复；QuAD 报告和主题标签保持隐藏。 对于每个等级，回复默认完整展示，评估者在继续之前需确认已查看这些内容。 此步骤还包含针对单条回复的典型/非典型判断以及透镜有用性评分。 在研究后的访谈汇报中，评估者表示他们不清楚这些判断的目的；因此我们将步骤 1 视为对数据的熟悉阶段，不对其判断进行分析。 该决定是在数据收集之后做出的。

sents.en: Step 1: blinded familiarization.
sents.zh: 步骤 1：盲测熟悉阶段。

sents.en: Evaluators received the research question and all 122 raw responses grouped by grade; the QuAD report and thematic labels remained hidden.

sents.zh: 对于每个等级，回复默认完整展示，评估者在继续之前需确认已查看这些内容。

sents.en: This step also contained response-level typical/unusual judgments and a lens-helpfulness rating.
sents.zh: 此步骤还包含针对单条回复的典型/非典型判断以及透镜有用性评分。

sents.en: In post-study debriefing, evaluators reported that the purpose of these judgments was unclear to them; we therefore treat Step 1 as familiarization with the data and do not analyze its judgments.

paragraphs.en: Step 2: report assessment. After completing Step 1, evaluators inspected the QuAD report, comprising the four metrics, their interpretation, and the surfaced responses. They rated three statements on seven-point agreement scales (1 = strongly disagree; 7 = strongly agree): correctness (the report’s conclusion about grade level is consistent with their own reading of the responses), interpretability (the metrics and their explanations are easy to understand), and usefulness for subsequent coding (the surfaced representative and unusual responses would help them start coding the data), followed by an optional comment. We report individual values and the median and range for each rating. With three evaluators, the evidence is interpreted as face validity; population-level inference requires a larger sample. The study has no comparison condition, so it does not test whether the report improves coding relative to reading the responses alone. The report shown to evaluators listed one non-substantive answer (C32, “none”) among the sophomore unusual responses; Appendix B.8.3 excludes such answers.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤 2：报告评估。 在完成步骤 1 后，评估者会查看 QuAD 报告，其中包含四项指标、其解读以及呈现的回复。 他们在七点同意度量表（1 = 非常不同意；7 = 非常同意）上对三个陈述进行评分：正确性（报告关于年级水平的结论与他们自己对回复的解读一致）、可理解性（指标及其解释易于理解）以及对后续编码的有用性（所呈现的代表性回复和异常回复有助于他们着手对数据进行编码），随后可填写一条可选评论。 我们报告每项评分的个体值以及中位数和范围。 由于只有三位评估者，该证据被解读为表面效度；总体层面的推断需要更大的样本。 本研究没有对照条件，因此无法检验相对于仅阅读回复而言，该报告是否能改进编码。 展示给评估者的报告中，在二年级学生的异常回复中列出了一条非实质性回答（C32，“无”）；附录 B.8.3 排除了此类回答。

paragraphs.en: Results. Tab. 16 reports the Step-2 ratings. No rating fell below the scale midpoint, and eight of the nine ratings were 6 or 7. Interpretability and usefulness for subsequent coding both reached a median of 6 (range 6–7), indicating that evaluators found the metrics and explanations understandable and the surfaced representative and unusual responses useful as starting points for coding. Correctness also reached a median of 6 but varied more (range 4–7): two evaluators agreed that the conclusion that grade level is a weak lens matched their own reading, whereas E1 was neutral. No evaluator left an optional comment. These results provide face-validity evidence that analysts find the QuAD report understandable and useful for starting subsequent coding; they do not establish effects on final coding outcomes, nor that the unusual responses yield new insights, which would require independent judgments of their analytical value.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 表16报告了第二步的评分。 没有任何评分低于量表中点，且九项评分中有八项为6或7。 可解释性和对后续编码的有用性均达到中位数6（范围6–7），表明评估者认为这些指标和解释易于理解，并且所呈现的代表性回答与异常回答作为编码起点是有用的。 正确性同样达到中位数6，但波动更大（范围4–7）：两位评估者一致认为“年级水平是一个较弱的透镜”这一结论与他们自己的解读相符，而E1持中立态度。 没有评估者留下选填的评论。 这些结果提供了表面效度证据，表明分析师认为QuAD报告易于理解且有助于开启后续编码；但这些结果并未确立其对最终编码结果的影响，也未确立异常回答能带来新的洞见，后者需要对异常回答的分析价值进行独立判断才能成立。

paragraphs.en: Many qualitative-data-analysis workflows interleave data collection and analysis. Researchers often begin familiarization and preliminary coding on a pilot subset, then refine the research question, sampling strategy, codebook, or analytical lens as patterns emerge. New data may prompt further revisions to the study scope or earlier interpretations, with contextual and theoretical judgment guiding these decisions throughout the process ( Glaser and Strauss, 2017 ; Campbell et al., 2013 ; Ames et al., 2024 ; Naeem et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 许多定性数据分析流程将数据收集与分析交替进行。 研究人员通常先在一个试点子集上开始熟悉数据并进行初步编码，然后随着模式的显现，不断修正研究问题、抽样策略、编码手册或分析视角。 新数据可能促使对研究范围或早期解释作进一步修订，而在整个过程中，情境判断与理论判断将指导这些决策（Glaser and Strauss, 2017；Campbell et al., 2013；Ames et al., 2024；Naeem et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Many qualitative-data-analysis workflows interleave data collection and analysis.
sents.zh: 许多定性数据分析流程将数据收集与分析交替进行。

sents.en: Researchers often begin familiarization and preliminary coding on a pilot subset, then refine the research question, sampling strategy, codebook, or analytical lens as patterns emerge.
sents.zh: 研究人员通常先在一个试点子集上开始熟悉数据并进行初步编码，然后随着模式的显现，不断修正研究问题、抽样策略、编码手册或分析视角。

sents.en: New data may prompt further revisions to the study scope or earlier interpretations, with contextual and theoretical judgment guiding these decisions throughout the process ( Glaser and Strauss, 2017 ; Campbell et al., 2013 ; Ames et al., 2024 ; Naeem et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 新数据可能促使对研究范围或早期解释作进一步修订，而在整个过程中，情境判断与理论判断将指导这些决策（Glaser and Strauss, 2017；Campbell et al., 2013；Ames et al., 2024；Naeem et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: QuAD can support this iterative workflow as a repeatable diagnostic checkpoint. On a pilot corpus, researchers can use the pairwise regime to assess a proposed analytical lens and identify central or unusual responses for close reading. They can then combine these signals with preliminary coding to revise the evaluation instruction, analytical lens, sampling plan, or study scope. As responses accumulate, the same assessment can be repeated to examine how the dataset structure changes; the scalar-projection regime supports this process when the corpus becomes larger.
paragraphs.zh: QuAD 可以作为一个可重复的诊断检查点来支持这一迭代式工作流程。 在试点语料库上，研究者可以使用成对评估机制来检验某个拟用的分析视角，并识别出适合细读的核心或异常响应。 然后，他们可以将这些信号与初步编码相结合，以修订评估指令、分析视角、抽样方案或研究范围。 随着响应不断累积，可以重复进行相同的评估以考察数据集结构如何变化；当语料库规模变大时，标量投影机制可以支持这一过程。
