paragraphs.en: At each checkpoint, the four metrics are read together as one profile, from lens-level relations to within-cluster variation. GMR summarizes alignment between the selected lens and reconstructed response clusters; DDR summarizes how well the analytical groups separate responses; DC characterizes within-cluster dispersion; and DP characterizes analytical-group mixing within clusters. A separate response-mining ranking identifies central and unusual cases. Researchers can use these signals to continue with the current lens, investigate cross-group themes, inspect outliers, or revise the next round of data collection and analysis. Tab. 17 maps typical signal combinations to these next steps; the food-choice case study corresponds to the second row. These mappings are reading guides for close inspection rather than automatic decision rules.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个检查点，四个指标作为一个整体剖面来解读，从透镜层面的关系到簇内变异。 GMR 概括所选透镜与重构的响应聚类之间的对齐程度；DDR 概括分析组区分响应的效果；DC 刻画簇内离散度；DP 刻画簇内分析组的混合程度。 一项单独的响应挖掘排序用于识别核心案例和异常案例。 研究者可以依据这些信号继续使用当前透镜、调查跨组主题、检视离群值，或修改下一轮数据收集与分析。 表 17 将典型的信号组合映射到这些后续步骤；食物选择案例研究对应第二行。 这些映射是供深入检视使用的阅读指南，而非自动化的决策规则。

paragraphs.en: Current evidence supports using QuAD for analytical-lens assessment and response triage at iterative pre-analysis checkpoints. The independent-evaluator study further examined whether analysts judge the report’s lens-level conclusion consistent with their own reading and find the report useful for subsequent coding. Establishing effects on final codes, themes, and interpretations requires a controlled comparison of QDA workflows with and without QuAD assistance. Operational scaling and cost measurements are reported separately in Appendix A.6 . Limitations and ethical considerations are stated after the Conclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 目前的证据支持在迭代式分析前检查点使用 QuAD 进行分析视角评估与回复分诊。 独立评估者研究进一步考察了分析人员是否认为报告的视角层面结论与其自身阅读一致，并认为该报告对后续编码有用。 要确定对最终编码、主题和解释的影响，需要对有和无 QuAD 辅助的 QDA 工作流程进行受控比较。 运行扩展与成本测量结果在附录 A.6 中单独报告。 局限性与伦理考量在结论之后阐述。

paragraphs.en: The UI is not intended as a full qualitative-analysis workbench and is not the central contribution evaluated by the user study. Its goal is narrower: to provide a controlled interface through which participants generate or refine task-specific dissimilarity evaluation instructions for the Stage 2 human-in-the-loop adaptation described in Sec. 3.1.2 . Both experimental conditions use the same overall UI layout. The baseline condition disables agent-assisted features and requires participants to write or refine prompts manually, while our condition provides an auto-generated initial prompt and agent-assisted refinement. This design reduces the risk that the user-study results are driven by UI layout differences rather than instruction-generation assistance. paragraphs.en: Traditional Qualitative Analysis and Data Quality. Qualitative responses from semi-structured questions are commonly analyzed through interpretive procedures such as familiarization with the corpus, open coding, codebook construction, theme grouping, interpretation, and validation ( Denzin and Lincoln, 2011 ; Glaser and Strauss, 2017 ; Campbell et al., 2013 ) . Quality and rigor are often discussed through notions such as richness, thickness, data saturation, and reliability or agreement among coders ( Ames et al., 2024 ; Naeem et al., 2024 ; Johnson et al., 2020 ) . These traditions emphasize contextual interpretation and theory building, rather than automatically deciding whether a collected response set supports a particular demographic or user-defined analysis axis.
paragraphs.zh: 传统定性分析与数据质量。 来自半结构化问题的定性回答通常通过解释性流程进行分析，例如熟悉语料、开放式编码、构建编码手册、主题分组、解释与验证（Denzin and Lincoln, 2011；Glaser and Strauss, 2017；Campbell et al., 2013）。 质量与严谨性通常通过诸如丰富性、厚度、数据饱和以及编码者之间的信度或一致性等概念来讨论（Ames et al., 2024；Naeem et al., 2024；Johnson et al., 2020）。 这些传统强调情境化解释与理论构建，而非自动判断所收集的回答集合是否支持某个特定的人口属性或用户定义的分析轴。

paragraphs.en: Computational Support for Qualitative Data. Computational methods have long been used to summarize or structure qualitative text, but early NLP approaches often struggle to preserve the semantic nuance needed for qualitative interpretation ( Manning and Schutze, 1999 ; Cambria and White, 2014 ; Chang et al., 2009 ) . Recent LLM-based work shows promise for qualitative coding and text assessment, including automatic coding assistance and reference-free text quality evaluation ( Parfenova et al., 2024 ; Barros et al., 2025 ; Dunivin, 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023b ) . However, much of this work focuses on individual responses or on producing codes, leaving a gap for dataset-level pre-analysis signals that help researchers decide whether a selected analytical lens is promising before committing to full manual coding.
paragraphs.zh: 定性数据的计算支持。 计算方法长期以来被用于总结或组织定性文本，但早期的自然语言处理方法往往难以保留定性解释所需的语义细微差别（Manning and Schutze, 1999; Cambria and White, 2014; Chang et al., 2009）。 近期基于大语言模型的研究在定性编码与文本评估方面展现出前景，包括自动编码辅助和无需参考文本的质量评估（Parfenova et al., 2024; Barros et al., 2025; Dunivin, 2024; Liu et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2023b）。 然而，这些工作大多聚焦于单个回答或生成编码，在数据集层面的预分析信号方面留下了空白，而此类信号能帮助研究者在投入完整的人工编码之前，判断所选的分析视角是否有前景。

paragraphs.en: QuAD ’s Position. QuAD complements rather than replaces traditional qualitative analysis. Before coding, it quantitatively assesses whether a response set supports a researcher-selected analytical lens, that is, whether the intrinsic response structure aligns with, diverges from, or is orthogonal to that lens; it also prioritizes responses for close reading. Its four metrics are not adopted wholesale from social-science coding practice but adapt ideas from distribution alignment and cluster structure to this pre-analysis setting. Two simpler alternatives are examined on the case study. A direct end-to-end LLM assessment, which asks the model for the verdict and triage at once, does not reproduce QuAD ’s lens verdict and is sensitive to response order (Appendix B.5 ). A code-then-test workflow first codes responses and then tests the association between codes and metadata. In the scalar regime, QuAD ’s instruction is itself a one-dimensional codebook, and standard tests on the same scores agree with DDR, the group-separation component of the profile (Appendix B.6 ). Such tests answer whether groups differ; the profile additionally grades how far the lens explains response structure, describes group mixing and within-cluster variation, and also applies to the pairwise regime, where no single score exists.
paragraphs.zh: QuAD的定位。 QuAD是对传统定性分析的补充，而非替代。 在编码之前，它先定量评估一组回复是否支持研究者选定的分析视角，即回复的内在结构是与该视角一致、相悖还是正交；它还会对需要精读的回复进行优先级排序。 它的四个指标并非整体照搬社会科学编码实践，而是将分布对齐与聚类结构的思想适配到这一预分析场景中。 我们在案例研究中考察了两种更简单的替代方案。 直接的端到端LLM评估——即让模型一次性给出判定与分诊——无法复现QuAD的视角判定，且对回复顺序敏感（附录B.5）。 先编码后检验的工作流先对回复进行编码，然后检验编码结果与元数据之间的关联。 在标量模式下，QuAD的指令本身就是一个一维编码本，对相同分数进行的标准检验与作为画像中组间分离成分的DDR结果一致（附录B.6）。 这类检验只回答各组是否不同；而画像还能进一步衡量该视角在多大程度上解释了回复结构，刻画组间混合情况与簇内变异，并且同样适用于不存在单一分数的成对模式。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based Automated Evaluation. Our dissimilarity extraction module builds on the “LLM-as-a-Judge” paradigm, where LLMs serve as scalable proxies for human judgments ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ) . This paradigm remains sensitive to position and verbosity biases, prompt wording, and scoring drift ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Saito et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Schroeder and Wood-Doughty, 2024 ) . QuAD addresses these limitations for qualitative response assessment through interactive instruction generation and adaptive anchors, which make dissimilarity judgments more domain-aware and more consistent across many LLM calls.
paragraphs.zh: 基于LLM的自动评估。 我们的相异性提取模块建立在「LLM作为裁判」范式之上，其中LLM作为人类判断的可扩展代理（Zheng et al., 2023；Kim et al., 2023；Zhu et al., 2023）。 该范式仍然对位置偏差、冗长偏差、提示措辞以及评分漂移较为敏感（Ye et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2023；Shi et al., 2024；Saito et al., 2023；Lee et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2024；Schroeder and Wood-Doughty, 2024）。 QuAD通过交互式指令生成和自适应锚点来解决定性响应评估中的这些局限，使相异性判断更具领域感知能力，并在多次LLM调用之间更加一致。

paragraphs.en: This section provides examples of prompts and results for automated instruction discovery, focusing on a small-scale case as an example.
paragraphs.zh: 本节提供自动化指令发现的提示与结果示例，并以一个小规模案例为例进行说明。

paragraphs.en: This instruction was selected for the synthetic proficiency task, whose ground-truth dissimilarity is the gap between latent proficiency scores. It therefore asks the judge to compare the two respondents’ levels and report their difference; for criteria without such a latent scale, the same pairwise call compares the two responses directly. The returned difference score is used as δ \delta . The gap and the banded guide in the instruction are both monotone in the estimated gap, so Spearman correlations do not depend on which one the judge follows, whereas Pearson correlations and distance-based metrics are computed on the scale of the returned score.
paragraphs.zh: 该指令是为合成熟练度任务选定的，其真值差异是潜在熟练度分数之间的差距。 因此它要求评判者比较两名回答者的水平并报告其差异；对于没有这种潜在量表的标准，同样的成对调用则直接比较两个回答。 返回的差异分数被用作 δ \delta 。 指令中的差距和分档指南都随估计差距单调变化，因此 Spearman 相关性不取决于评判者遵循哪一个，而 Pearson 相关性和基于距离的指标则是基于返回分数的尺度计算的。
